## **Full Example: Admin Upload Page**

```tsx
"use client";
import { useState, useRef } from "react";
import * as poseDetection from "@tensorflow-models/pose-detection";
import "@tensorflow/tfjs-backend-webgl";
import * as tf from "@tensorflow/tfjs-core";

const ADMIN_PASSWORD = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_ADMIN_PASSWORD || "letmein";

export default function AdminUpload() {
  // Security
  const [authorized, setAuthorized] = useState(false);
  const [input, setInput] = useState("");

  // Video/keypoints
  const [videoUrl, setVideoUrl] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [keypoints, setKeypoints] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [processing, setProcessing] = useState(false);
  const [selectedFrame, setSelectedFrame] = useState(0);

  const videoRef = useRef<HTMLVideoElement>(null);
  const fileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const canvasRef = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement>(null);

  // Handle file upload
  const handleUpload = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (file) {
      setVideoUrl(URL.createObjectURL(file));
      setKeypoints([]);
      setSelectedFrame(0);
    }
  };

  // Extract keypoints from video
  const extractKeypoints = async () => {
    if (!videoRef.current) return;
    setProcessing(true);
    await tf.setBackend("webgl");
    await tf.ready();
    const detector = await poseDetection.createDetector(
      poseDetection.SupportedModels.MoveNet,
      { modelType: poseDetection.movenet.modelType.SINGLEPOSE_LIGHTNING }
    );
    const video = videoRef.current;
    const poses: any[] = [];
    video.currentTime = 0;

    // Wait for video metadata to load
    await new Promise((resolve) => {
      if (video.readyState >= 1) resolve(true);
      else video.onloadedmetadata = () => resolve(true);
    });

    // Process every Nth frame (e.g., every 3rd frame for speed)
    const step = 3;
    const frameRate = video.frameRate || 30;
    for (let t = 0; t < video.duration; t += step / frameRate) {
      video.currentTime = t;
      await new Promise((resolve) => (video.onseeked = resolve));
      const pose = await detector.estimatePoses(video);
      poses.push(pose[0] || null);
    }
    setKeypoints(poses);
    setProcessing(false);
    setSelectedFrame(0);
  };

  // Download keypoints as JSON
  const downloadKeypoints = () => {
    const blob = new Blob([JSON.stringify(keypoints, null, 2)], { type: "application/json" });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const a = document.createElement("a");
    a.href = url;
    a.download = "keypoints.json";
    a.click();
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  };

  // Draw skeleton for selected frame
  const drawSkeleton = () => {
    const canvas = canvasRef.current;
    if (!canvas || !keypoints[selectedFrame]) return;
    const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
    if (!ctx) return;
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

    const pose = keypoints[selectedFrame];
    if (!pose || !pose.keypoints) return;

    // Draw lines
    const adjacentPairs = poseDetection.util.getAdjacentPairs(poseDetection.SupportedModels.MoveNet);
    adjacentPairs.forEach(([i, j]) => {
      const kp1 = pose.keypoints[i];
      const kp2 = pose.keypoints[j];
      if (
        kp1 &&
        kp2 &&
        kp1.score !== undefined &&
        kp2.score !== undefined &&
        kp1.score > 0.4 &&
        kp2.score > 0.4
      ) {
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(kp1.x, kp1.y);
        ctx.lineTo(kp2.x, kp2.y);
        ctx.strokeStyle = "#64FF58";
        ctx.lineWidth = 3;
        ctx.stroke();
      }
    });

    // Draw points
    pose.keypoints.forEach((keypoint: any) => {
      if (keypoint.score && keypoint.score > 0.4) {
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(keypoint.x, keypoint.y, 6, 0, 2 * Math.PI);
        ctx.fillStyle = "#1E3A8A";
        ctx.fill();
      }
    });
  };

  // Redraw skeleton when frame or keypoints change
  React.useEffect(() => {
    drawSkeleton();
  }, [selectedFrame, keypoints]);

  // Basic stats
  const numFrames = keypoints.length;
  const avgConfidence =
    numFrames > 0
      ? (
          keypoints
            .map(
              (pose) =>
                pose &&
                pose.keypoints &&
                pose.keypoints
                  .filter((kp: any) => typeof kp.score === "number")
                  .reduce((sum: number, kp: any) => sum + kp.score, 0) /
                  pose.keypoints.length
            )
            .filter(Boolean)
            .reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / numFrames
        ).toFixed(2)
      : 0;
  const framesWithPerson = keypoints.filter(
    (pose) => pose && pose.keypoints && pose.keypoints.some((kp: any) => kp.score > 0.4)
  ).length;

  // Security
  if (!authorized) {
    return (
      <main className="min-h-screen flex flex-col items-center justify-center bg-onyx-100">
        <div className="bg-onyx-90 p-8 rounded shadow flex flex-col items-center">
          <h1 className="text-xl font-bold mb-4 text-onyx-10">Admin Access</h1>
          <input
            type="password"
            placeholder="Enter admin password"
            value={input}
            onChange={e => setInput(e.target.value)}
            className="mb-4 px-3 py-2 rounded border border-onyx-30 focus:outline-none"
          />
          <button
            className="bg-blue-100 text-white px-4 py-2 rounded font-bold shadow hover:bg-blue-90 transition"
            onClick={() => {
              if (input === ADMIN_PASSWORD) setAuthorized(true);
              else alert("Incorrect password");
            }}
          >
            Enter
          </button>
        </div>
      </main>
    );
  }

  return (
    <main className="min-h-screen bg-onyx-100 flex flex-col items-center px-4 py-8">
      <h1 className="text-2xl font-extrabold text-onyx-10 mb-4">
        Admin: Upload Reference Video
      </h1>
      <label
        className="bg-blue-100 text-white px-4 py-2 rounded font-bold shadow hover:bg-blue-90 transition cursor-pointer mb-4 inline-block"
        onClick={() => fileInputRef.current?.click()}
      >
        Upload Video
        <input
          ref={fileInputRef}
          type="file"
          accept="video/*"
          onChange={handleUpload}
          className="hidden"
        />
      </label>
      {videoUrl && (
        <video
          ref={videoRef}
          src={videoUrl}
          controls
          className="rounded w-[180px] h-[320px] mb-4"
        />
      )}
      {videoUrl && (
        <button
          className="bg-blue-100 text-white px-4 py-2 rounded font-bold shadow-lg hover:bg-blue-90 transition mb-4"
          onClick={extractKeypoints}
          disabled={processing}
        >
          {processing ? "Processing..." : "Extract Keypoints"}
        </button>
      )}
      {keypoints.length > 0 && (
        <>
          <button
            className="bg-green-60 text-white px-4 py-2 rounded font-bold shadow-lg hover:bg-green-70 transition mb-4"
            onClick={downloadKeypoints}
          >
            Download Keypoints JSON
          </button>
          <div className="mb-4 bg-white rounded p-4 shadow w-full max-w-md">
            <div className="font-bold mb-2">Keypoint Extraction Stats</div>
            <div>Frames processed: {numFrames}</div>
            <div>Frames with detected person: {framesWithPerson}</div>
            <div>Average confidence: {avgConfidence}</div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mt-2">
              <label htmlFor="frame" className="text-xs">Preview frame:</label>
              <input
                id="frame"
                type="range"
                min={0}
                max={numFrames - 1}
                value={selectedFrame}
                onChange={e => setSelectedFrame(Number(e.target.value))}
                className="w-32"
              />
              <span className="text-xs">{selectedFrame + 1}/{numFrames}</span>
            </div>
            <canvas
              ref={canvasRef}
              width={360}
              height={640}
              className="border mt-2 rounded"
              style={{ width: "180px", height: "320px" }}
            />
          </div>
        </>
      )}
    </main>
  );
}
```

---

## **What This Does:**
- Lets you upload and preview a video.
- Extracts keypoints for each frame (or every Nth frame for speed).
- Lets you download the keypoints as JSON.
- Shows basic stats about the extraction.
- Lets you preview the skeleton for any frame.

```typescriptreact
    adjacentPairs.forEach(([i, j]) => {
      const kp1 = pose.keypoints[i];
      const kp2 = pose.keypoints[j];
      if (
        kp1 &&
        kp2 &&
        kp1.score !== undefined &&
        kp2.score !== undefined &&
        kp1.score > 0.4 &&
        kp2.score > 0.4
      ) {
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(kp1.x, kp1.y);
        ctx.lineTo(kp2.x, kp2.y);
        ctx.strokeStyle = "#64FF58";
        ctx.lineWidth = 3;
        ctx.stroke();
      }
    });

    // Draw points
    pose.keypoints.forEach((keypoint: any) => {
      if (keypoint.score && keypoint.score > 0.4) {
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(keypoint.x, keypoint.y, 6, 0, 2 * Math.PI);
        ctx.fillStyle = "#1E3A8A";
        ctx.fill();
      }
    });
  };

  // Redraw skeleton when frame or keypoints change
  React.useEffect(() => {
    drawSkeleton();
  }, [selectedFrame, keypoints]);

  // Basic stats
  const numFrames = keypoints.length;
  const avgConfidence =
    numFrames > 0
      ? (
          keypoints
            .map(
              (pose) =>
                pose &&
                pose.keypoints &&
                pose.keypoints
                  .filter((kp: any) => typeof kp.score === "number")
                  .reduce((sum: number, kp: any) => sum + kp.score, 0) /
                  pose.keypoints.length
            )
            .filter(Boolean)
            .reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / numFrames
        ).toFixed(2)
      : 0;
  const framesWithPerson = keypoints.filter(
    (pose) => pose && pose.keypoints && pose.keypoints.some((kp: any) => kp.score > 0.4)
  ).length;

  // Security
  if (!authorized) {
    return (
      <main className="min-h-screen flex flex-col items-center justify-center bg-onyx-100">
        <div className="bg-onyx-90 p-8 rounded shadow flex flex-col items-center">
          <h1 className="text-xl font-bold mb-4 text-onyx-10">Admin Access</h1>
          <input
            type="password"
            placeholder="Enter admin password"
            value={input}
            onChange={e => setInput(e.target.value)}
            className="mb-4 px-3 py-2 rounded border border-onyx-30 focus:outline-none"
          />
          <button
            className="bg-blue-100 text-white px-4 py-2 rounded font-bold shadow hover:bg-blue-90 transition"
            onClick={() => {
              if (input === ADMIN_PASSWORD) setAuthorized(true);
              else alert("Incorrect password");
            }}
          >
            Enter
          </button>
        </div>
      </main>
    );
  }

  return (
    <main className="min-h-screen bg-onyx-100 flex flex-col items-center px-4 py-8">
      <h1 className="text-2xl font-extrabold text-onyx-10 mb-4">
        Admin: Upload Reference Video
      </h1>
      <label
        className="bg-blue-100 text-white px-4 py-2 rounded font-bold shadow hover:bg-blue-90 transition cursor-pointer mb-4 inline-block"
        onClick={() => fileInputRef.current?.click()}
      >
        Upload Video
        <input
          ref={fileInputRef}
          type="file"
          accept="video/*"
          onChange={handleUpload}
          className="hidden"
        />
      </label>
      {videoUrl && (
        <video
          ref={videoRef}
          src={videoUrl}
          controls
          className="rounded w-[180px] h-[320px] mb-4"
        />
      )}
      {videoUrl && (
        <button
          className="bg-blue-100 text-white px-4 py-2 rounded font-bold shadow-lg hover:bg-blue-90 transition mb-4"
          onClick={extractKeypoints}
          disabled={processing}
        >
          {processing ? "Processing..." : "Extract Keypoints"}
        </button>
      )}
      {keypoints.length > 0 && (
        <>
          <button
            className="bg-green-60 text-white px-4 py-2 rounded font-bold shadow-lg hover:bg-green-70 transition mb-4"
            onClick={downloadKeypoints}
          >
            Download Keypoints JSON
          </button>
          <div className="mb-4 bg-white rounded p-4 shadow w-full max-w-md">
            <div className="font-bold mb-2">Keypoint Extraction Stats</div>
            <div>Frames processed: {numFrames}</div>
            <div>Frames with detected person: {framesWithPerson}</div>
            <div>Average confidence: {avgConfidence}</div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mt-2">
              <label htmlFor="frame" className="text-xs">Preview frame:</label>
              <input
                id="frame"
                type="range"
                min={0}
                max={numFrames - 1}
                value={selectedFrame}
                onChange={e => setSelectedFrame(Number(e.target.value))}
                className="w-32"
              />
              <span className="text-xs">{selectedFrame + 1}/{numFrames}</span>
            </div>
            <canvas
              ref={canvasRef}
              width={360}
              height={640}
              className="border mt-2 rounded"
              style={{ width: "180px", height: "320px" }}
            />
          </div>
        </>
      )}
    </main>
  );
}
```

Great questions! Here’s how to address both warnings:

---

## 1. **Property 'frameRate' does not exist on type 'HTMLVideoElement'**

- The standard HTMLVideoElement does **not** have a `.frameRate` property.
- To estimate frame rate, you can use a default (e.g., 30fps) or let the user specify it, or use the video’s metadata if available (but most browsers don’t expose frame rate directly).

**Fix:**  
Replace:
```ts
const frameRate = video.frameRate || 30;
```
with:
```ts
const frameRate = 30; // or let the user input this if you want more accuracy
```

---

## 2. **'React' refers to a UMD global, but the current file is a module. Consider adding an import instead.**

- This warning means you’re using `React.useEffect` (or other React APIs) but haven’t imported `React` in your file.
- In Next.js/React 18+, you should always import React when using hooks in a file.

**Fix:**  
At the top of your file, add:
```ts
import React, { useState, useRef, useEffect } from "react";
```
Then, use `useEffect` instead of `React.useEffect`.

---

## **Summary of Fixes**

**At the top of your file:**
```ts
import React, { useState, useRef, useEffect } from "react";
```

**In your code:**
```ts
const frameRate = 30; // Use a default value
```
and

```ts
}, [selectedFrame, keypoints]);
```

## 1. **Aligning the Keypoint Preview with the Video Frame**

**Why the misalignment?**  
- The canvas for the keypoint preview must match the video’s actual frame size (width/height in pixels), not just the displayed size.
- Keypoints are in video pixel coordinates, so the canvas must use the same dimensions for accurate overlay.

**How to fix:**  
- When you load the video, set the canvas’s width and height to match the video’s `videoWidth` and `videoHeight`.
- When displaying the canvas, use CSS to scale it down for preview, but keep the drawing coordinates in the original pixel space.

**Example:**

```tsx
// When video is loaded, set canvas size
useEffect(() => {
  if (videoRef.current && canvasRef.current) {
    const video = videoRef.current;
    const canvas = canvasRef.current;
    const updateCanvasSize = () => {
      canvas.width = video.videoWidth;
      canvas.height = video.videoHeight;
    };
    video.addEventListener("loadedmetadata", updateCanvasSize);
    return () => video.removeEventListener("loadedmetadata", updateCanvasSize);
  }
}, [videoUrl]);
```

## **Step 1: Calculate Joint Angles (e.g., Knee Flexion) for Each Frame**

### **A. Utility Function to Calculate an Angle**

You need three keypoints (e.g., hip, knee, ankle for knee flexion):

```ts
function getAngle(a: {x: number, y: number}, b: {x: number, y: number}, c: {x: number, y: number}) {
  // Angle at point b (in degrees)
  const ab = { x: a.x - b.x, y: a.y - b.y };
  const cb = { x: c.x - b.x, y: c.y - b.y };
  const dot = ab.x * cb.x + ab.y * cb.y;
  const magAB = Math.sqrt(ab.x * ab.x + ab.y * ab.y);
  const magCB = Math.sqrt(cb.x * cb.x + cb.y * cb.y);
  const angleRad = Math.acos(dot / (magAB * magCB));
  return (angleRad * 180) / Math.PI;
}
```

---

### **B. Calculate Angles for Each Frame**

For MoveNet, keypoint indices are:
- 11: left hip, 13: left knee, 15: left ankle
- 12: right hip, 14: right knee, 16: right ankle

**Example:**

```ts
const leftKneeAngles = keypoints.map((pose) => {
  if (!pose || !pose.keypoints) return null;
  const hip = pose.keypoints[11];
  const knee = pose.keypoints[13];
  const ankle = pose.keypoints[15];
  if (
    hip?.score > 0.4 &&
    knee?.score > 0.4 &&
    ankle?.score > 0.4
  ) {
    return getAngle(hip, knee, ankle);
  }
  return null;
});
```

Repeat for right knee, hip, etc.

---

## **Step 2: Display Angle Stats and Chart**

**A. Calculate Stats:**

```ts
function getStats(arr: (number | null)[]) {
  const valid = arr.filter((v): v is number => v !== null);
  if (valid.length === 0) return { min: null, max: null, avg: null };
  const min = Math.min(...valid);
  const max = Math.max(...valid);
  const avg = valid.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / valid.length;
  return { min, max, avg };
}
const leftKneeStats = getStats(leftKneeAngles);
```

**B. Chart the Angles:**

Prepare data for Recharts:

```ts
const angleChartData = leftKneeAngles.map((angle, idx) => ({
  frame: idx + 1,
  angle,
}));
```

## **Full Example: Admin Upload Page with Biomechanical Analysis**

```tsx
"use client";
import React, { useState, useRef, useEffect } from "react";
import * as poseDetection from "@tensorflow-models/pose-detection";
import "@tensorflow/tfjs-backend-webgl";
import * as tf from "@tensorflow/tfjs-core";
import {
  LineChart,
  Line,
  XAxis,
  YAxis,
  Tooltip,
  ResponsiveContainer,
} from "recharts";

// Utility to calculate angle at point b (in degrees)
function getAngle(a: { x: number; y: number }, b: { x: number; y: number }, c: { x: number; y: number }) {
  const ab = { x: a.x - b.x, y: a.y - b.y };
  const cb = { x: c.x - b.x, y: c.y - b.y };
  const dot = ab.x * cb.x + ab.y * cb.y;
  const magAB = Math.sqrt(ab.x * ab.x + ab.y * ab.y);
  const magCB = Math.sqrt(cb.x * cb.x + cb.y * cb.y);
  const angleRad = Math.acos(dot / (magAB * magCB));
  return (angleRad * 180) / Math.PI;
}

const ADMIN_PASSWORD = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_ADMIN_PASSWORD || "letmein";

export default function AdminUpload() {
  // Security
  const [authorized, setAuthorized] = useState(false);
  const [input, setInput] = useState("");

  // Video/keypoints
  const [videoUrl, setVideoUrl] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [keypoints, setKeypoints] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [processing, setProcessing] = useState(false);
  const [selectedFrame, setSelectedFrame] = useState(0);

  const videoRef = useRef<HTMLVideoElement>(null);
  const fileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const canvasRef = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement>(null);

  // Handle file upload
  const handleUpload = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (file) {
      setVideoUrl(URL.createObjectURL(file));
      setKeypoints([]);
      setSelectedFrame(0);
    }
  };

  // Extract keypoints from video
  const extractKeypoints = async () => {
    if (!videoRef.current) return;
    setProcessing(true);
    await tf.setBackend("webgl");
    await tf.ready();
    const detector = await poseDetection.createDetector(
      poseDetection.SupportedModels.MoveNet,
      { modelType: poseDetection.movenet.modelType.SINGLEPOSE_LIGHTNING }
    );
    const video = videoRef.current;
    const poses: any[] = [];
    video.currentTime = 0;

    // Wait for video metadata to load
    await new Promise((resolve) => {
      if (video.readyState >= 1) resolve(true);
      else video.onloadedmetadata = () => resolve(true);
    });

    // Process every Nth frame (e.g., every 3rd frame for speed)
    const step = 3;
    const frameRate = 30; // Use a default value
    for (let t = 0; t < video.duration; t += step / frameRate) {
      video.currentTime = t;
      await new Promise((resolve) => (video.onseeked = resolve));
      const pose = await detector.estimatePoses(video);
      poses.push(pose[0] || null);
    }
    setKeypoints(poses);
    setProcessing(false);
    setSelectedFrame(0);
  };

  // Download keypoints as JSON
  const downloadKeypoints = () => {
    const blob = new Blob([JSON.stringify(keypoints, null, 2)], { type: "application/json" });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const a = document.createElement("a");
    a.href = url;
    a.download = "keypoints.json";
    a.click();
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  };

  // Draw skeleton for selected frame
  useEffect(() => {
    const canvas = canvasRef.current;
    if (!canvas || !keypoints[selectedFrame]) return;
    const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
    if (!ctx) return;
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

    const pose = keypoints[selectedFrame];
    if (!pose || !pose.keypoints) return;

    // Draw lines
    const adjacentPairs = poseDetection.util.getAdjacentPairs(poseDetection.SupportedModels.MoveNet);
    adjacentPairs.forEach(([i, j]) => {
      const kp1 = pose.keypoints[i];
      const kp2 = pose.keypoints[j];
      if (
        kp1 &&
        kp2 &&
        kp1.score !== undefined &&
        kp2.score !== undefined &&
        kp1.score > 0.4 &&
        kp2.score > 0.4
      ) {
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(kp1.x, kp1.y);
        ctx.lineTo(kp2.x, kp2.y);
        ctx.strokeStyle = "#64FF58";
        ctx.lineWidth = 3;
        ctx.stroke();
      }
    });

    // Draw points
    pose.keypoints.forEach((keypoint: any) => {
      if (keypoint.score && keypoint.score > 0.4) {
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(keypoint.x, keypoint.y, 6, 0, 2 * Math.PI);
        ctx.fillStyle = "#1E3A8A";
        ctx.fill();
      }
    });
  }, [selectedFrame, keypoints]);

  // Set canvas size to match video
  useEffect(() => {
    if (videoRef.current && canvasRef.current) {
      const video = videoRef.current;
      const canvas = canvasRef.current;
      const updateCanvasSize = () => {
        canvas.width = video.videoWidth;
        canvas.height = video.videoHeight;
      };
      video.addEventListener("loadedmetadata", updateCanvasSize);
      return () => video.removeEventListener("loadedmetadata", updateCanvasSize);
    }
  }, [videoUrl]);

  // Calculate left knee angles for each frame
  const leftKneeAngles = keypoints.map((pose) => {
    if (!pose || !pose.keypoints) return null;
    const hip = pose.keypoints[11];
    const knee = pose.keypoints[13];
    const ankle = pose.keypoints[15];
    if (
      hip?.score > 0.4 &&
      knee?.score > 0.4 &&
      ankle?.score > 0.4
    ) {
      return getAngle(hip, knee, ankle);
    }
    return null;
  });

  // Stats for left knee angle
  function getStats(arr: (number | null)[]) {
    const valid = arr.filter((v): v is number => v !== null);
    if (valid.length === 0) return { min: null, max: null, avg: null };
    const min = Math.min(...valid);
    const max = Math.max(...valid);
    const avg = valid.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / valid.length;
    return { min, max, avg };
  }
  const leftKneeStats = getStats(leftKneeAngles);

  // Chart data
  const angleChartData = leftKneeAngles.map((angle, idx) => ({
    frame: idx + 1,
    angle,
  }));

  // Template-based summary
  const summary = leftKneeStats.avg
    ? `Average left knee flexion: ${leftKneeStats.avg.toFixed(1)}°. Max: ${leftKneeStats.max?.toFixed(1)}°, Min: ${leftKneeStats.min?.toFixed(1)}°.`
    : "Not enough data to calculate knee flexion.";

  // Basic stats
  const numFrames = keypoints.length;
  const framesWithPerson = keypoints.filter(
    (pose) => pose && pose.keypoints && pose.keypoints.some((kp: any) => kp.score > 0.4)
  ).length;
  const avgConfidence =
    numFrames > 0
      ? (
          keypoints
            .map(
              (pose) =>
                pose &&
                pose.keypoints &&
                pose.keypoints
                  .filter((kp: any) => typeof kp.score === "number")
                  .reduce((sum: number, kp: any) => sum + kp.score, 0) /
                  pose.keypoints.length
            )
            .filter(Boolean)
            .reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / numFrames
        ).toFixed(2)
      : 0;

  // Security
  if (!authorized) {
    return (
      <main className="min-h-screen flex flex-col items-center justify-center bg-onyx-100">
        <div className="bg-onyx-90 p-8 rounded shadow flex flex-col items-center">
          <h1 className="text-xl font-bold mb-4 text-onyx-10">Admin Access</h1>
          <input
            type="password"
            placeholder="Enter admin password"
            value={input}
            onChange={e => setInput(e.target.value)}
            className="mb-4 px-3 py-2 rounded border border-onyx-30 focus:outline-none"
          />
          <button
            className="bg-blue-100 text-white px-4 py-2 rounded font-bold shadow hover:bg-blue-90 transition"
            onClick={() => {
              if (input === ADMIN_PASSWORD) setAuthorized(true);
              else alert("Incorrect password");
            }}
          >
            Enter
          </button>
        </div>
      </main>
    );
  }

  return (
    <main className="min-h-screen bg-onyx-100 flex flex-col items-center px-4 py-8">
      <h1 className="text-2xl font-extrabold text-onyx-10 mb-4">
        Admin: Upload Reference Video
      </h1>
      <button
        className="bg-blue-100 text-white px-4 py-2 rounded font-bold shadow hover:bg-blue-90 transition cursor-pointer mb-4 inline-block"
        onClick={() => fileInputRef.current?.click()}
        type="button"
      >
        Upload Video
      </button>
      <input
        ref={fileInputRef}
        type="file"
        accept="video/*"
        onChange={handleUpload}
        className="hidden"
      />
      {videoUrl && (
        <video
          ref={videoRef}
          src={videoUrl}
          controls
          className="rounded w-[180px] h-[320px] mb-4"
        />
      )}
      {videoUrl && (
        <button
          className="bg-blue-100 text-white px-4 py-2 rounded font-bold shadow-lg hover:bg-blue-90 transition mb-4"
          onClick={extractKeypoints}
          disabled={processing}
        >
          {processing ? "Processing..." : "Extract Keypoints"}
        </button>
      )}
      {keypoints.length > 0 && (
        <>
          <button
            className="bg-green-60 text-white px-4 py-2 rounded font-bold shadow-lg hover:bg-green-70 transition mb-4 border-2 border-green-80"
            onClick={downloadKeypoints}
          >
            ⬇️ Download Keypoints JSON
          </button>
          <div className="mb-4 bg-white rounded p-4 shadow w-full max-w-md">
            <div className="font-bold mb-2">Keypoint Extraction Stats</div>
            <div>Frames processed: {numFrames}</div>
            <div>Frames with detected person: {framesWithPerson}</div>
            <div>Average confidence: {avgConfidence}</div>
            <div className="font-bold mt-4">Left Knee Flexion (°)</div>
            <div>Min: {leftKneeStats.min?.toFixed(1) ?? "N/A"}</div>
            <div>Max: {leftKneeStats.max?.toFixed(1) ?? "N/A"}</div>
            <div>Avg: {leftKneeStats.avg?.toFixed(1) ?? "N/A"}</div>
            <div className="font-bold mt-4">Summary</div>
            <div className="mb-2">{summary}</div>
            <div className="w-full h-48 mb-4">
              <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height="100%">
                <LineChart data={angleChartData}>
                  <XAxis dataKey="frame" />
                  <YAxis domain={[0, 180]} label={{ value: "Knee Angle (°)", angle: -90, position: "insideLeft" }} />
                  <Tooltip />
                  <Line type="monotone" dataKey="angle" stroke="#F81818" strokeWidth={2} dot={false} />
                </LineChart>
              </ResponsiveContainer>
            </div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mt-2">
              <label htmlFor="frame" className="text-xs">Preview frame:</label>
              <input
                id="frame"
                type="range"
                min={0}
                max={numFrames - 1}
                value={selectedFrame}
                onChange={e => setSelectedFrame(Number(e.target.value))}
                className="w-32"
              />
              <span className="text-xs">{selectedFrame + 1}/{numFrames}</span>
            </div>
            <canvas
              ref={canvasRef}
              width={videoRef.current?.videoWidth || 360}
              height={videoRef.current?.videoHeight || 640}
              className="border mt-2 rounded"
              style={{ width: "180px", height: "320px" }}
            />
          </div>
        </>
      )}
    </main>
  );
}
```

```typescriptreact
"use client";
import React, { useState, useRef, useEffect } from "react";
import * as poseDetection from "@tensorflow-models/pose-detection";
import "@tensorflow/tfjs-backend-webgl";
import * as tf from "@tensorflow/tfjs-core";
import {
  LineChart,
  Line,
  XAxis,
  YAxis,
  Tooltip,
  ResponsiveContainer,
} from "recharts";

// Utility to calculate angle at point b (in degrees)
function getAngle(a: { x: number; y: number }, b: { x: number; y: number }, c: { x: number; y: number }) {
  const ab = { x: a.x - b.x, y: a.y - b.y };
  const cb = { x: c.x - b.x, y: c.y - b.y };
  const dot = ab.x * cb.x + ab.y * cb.y;
  const magAB = Math.sqrt(ab.x * ab.x + ab.y * ab.y);
  const magCB = Math.sqrt(cb.x * cb.x + cb.y * cb.y);
  const angleRad = Math.acos(dot / (magAB * magCB));
  return (angleRad * 180) / Math.PI;
}

const ADMIN_PASSWORD = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_ADMIN_PASSWORD || "letmein";

  // Security
  const [authorized, setAuthorized] = useState(false);
  const [input, setInput] = useState("");

  const [keypoints, setKeypoints] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [processing, setProcessing] = useState(false);
  const [selectedFrame, setSelectedFrame] = useState(0);

  const videoRef = useRef<HTMLVideoElement>(null);
  const fileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const canvasRef = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement>(null);

  // Handle file upload
  const handleUpload = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (file) {
      setVideoUrl(URL.createObjectURL(file));
      setKeypoints([]);
      setSelectedFrame(0);
    }
  };

  // Extract keypoints from video
  const extractKeypoints = async () => {
    if (!videoRef.current) return;
    setProcessing(true);
    await tf.setBackend("webgl");
    await tf.ready();
    const detector = await poseDetection.createDetector(
      poseDetection.SupportedModels.MoveNet,
      { modelType: poseDetection.movenet.modelType.SINGLEPOSE_LIGHTNING }
    );
    const video = videoRef.current;
    const poses: any[] = [];
    video.currentTime = 0;

    // Wait for video metadata to load
    await new Promise((resolve) => {
      if (video.readyState >= 1) resolve(true);
      else video.onloadedmetadata = () => resolve(true);
    });

    // Process every Nth frame (e.g., every 3rd frame for speed)
    const step = 3;
    const frameRate = 30; // Use a default value
    for (let t = 0; t < video.duration; t += step / frameRate) {
      video.currentTime = t;
      await new Promise((resolve) => (video.onseeked = resolve));
      const pose = await detector.estimatePoses(video);
      poses.push(pose[0] || null);
    }
    setKeypoints(poses);
    setProcessing(false);
    setSelectedFrame(0);
  };

  // Download keypoints as JSON
  const downloadKeypoints = () => {
    const blob = new Blob([JSON.stringify(keypoints, null, 2)], { type: "application/json" });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const a = document.createElement("a");
    a.href = url;
    a.download = "keypoints.json";
    a.click();
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);

  // Draw skeleton for selected frame
  useEffect(() => {

    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

    if (!pose || !pose.keypoints) return;

    // Draw lines

    adjacentPairs.forEach(([i, j]) => {
      const kp1 = pose.keypoints[i];
      const kp2 = pose.keypoints[j];
      if (
        kp1 &&
        kp2 &&
        kp1.score !== undefined &&
        kp2.score !== undefined &&
        kp1.score > 0.4 &&
        kp2.score > 0.4
      ) {
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(kp1.x, kp1.y);
        ctx.lineTo(kp2.x, kp2.y);
        ctx.strokeStyle = "#64FF58";
        ctx.lineWidth = 3;
        ctx.stroke();
      }
    });

    // Draw points
    pose.keypoints.forEach((keypoint: any) => {
      if (keypoint.score && keypoint.score > 0.4) {
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(keypoint.x, keypoint.y, 6, 0, 2 * Math.PI);
        ctx.fillStyle = "#1E3A8A";
        ctx.fill();
      }
    });
  }, [selectedFrame, keypoints]);

  // Set canvas size to match video
  useEffect(() => {
    if (videoRef.current && canvasRef.current) {
      const video = videoRef.current;
      const canvas = canvasRef.current;
      const updateCanvasSize = () => {
        canvas.width = video.videoWidth;
        canvas.height = video.videoHeight;
      };
      video.addEventListener("loadedmetadata", updateCanvasSize);
      return () => video.removeEventListener("loadedmetadata", updateCanvasSize);
    }
  }, [videoUrl]);

  // Calculate left knee angles for each frame
  const leftKneeAngles = keypoints.map((pose) => {
    if (!pose || !pose.keypoints) return null;
    const hip = pose.keypoints[11];
    const knee = pose.keypoints[13];
    const ankle = pose.keypoints[15];
    if (
      hip?.score > 0.4 &&
      knee?.score > 0.4 &&
      ankle?.score > 0.4
    ) {
      return getAngle(hip, knee, ankle);
    }
    return null;
  });

  // Stats for left knee angle
  function getStats(arr: (number | null)[]) {
    const valid = arr.filter((v): v is number => v !== null);
    if (valid.length === 0) return { min: null, max: null, avg: null };
    const min = Math.min(...valid);
    const max = Math.max(...valid);
    const avg = valid.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / valid.length;
    return { min, max, avg };
  }
  const leftKneeStats = getStats(leftKneeAngles);

  // Chart data
  const angleChartData = leftKneeAngles.map((angle, idx) => ({
    frame: idx + 1,
    angle,
  }));

  // Template-based summary
  const summary = leftKneeStats.avg
    ? `Average left knee flexion: ${leftKneeStats.avg.toFixed(1)}°. Max: ${leftKneeStats.max?.toFixed(1)}°, Min: ${leftKneeStats.min?.toFixed(1)}°.`
    : "Not enough data to calculate knee flexion.";

  // Basic stats
  const numFrames = keypoints.length;
  const framesWithPerson = keypoints.filter(
    (pose) => pose && pose.keypoints && pose.keypoints.some((kp: any) => kp.score > 0.4)
  ).length;
  const avgConfidence =
    numFrames > 0
      ? (
          keypoints
            .map(
              (pose) =>
                pose &&
                pose.keypoints &&
                pose.keypoints
                  .filter((kp: any) => typeof kp.score === "number")
                  .reduce((sum: number, kp: any) => sum + kp.score, 0) /
                  pose.keypoints.length
            )
            .filter(Boolean)
            .reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / numFrames
        ).toFixed(2)
      : 0;

  // Security
  if (!authorized) {
    return (
      <main className="min-h-screen flex flex-col items-center justify-center bg-onyx-100">
        <div className="bg-onyx-90 p-8 rounded shadow flex flex-col items-center">
          <h1 className="text-xl font-bold mb-4 text-onyx-10">Admin Access</h1>
```

---

## **Common Biomechanical Calculations to Include**

Here are some valuable metrics you can add (using the same approach as for knee flexion):

### **1. Hip Flexion/Extension**
- **Left hip:** Use shoulder (5), hip (11), knee (13)
- **Right hip:** Use shoulder (6), hip (12), knee (14)

### **2. Elbow Flexion/Extension**
- **Left elbow:** Use shoulder (5), elbow (7), wrist (9)
- **Right elbow:** Use shoulder (6), elbow (8), wrist (10)

### **3. Shoulder Abduction/Adduction**
- **Left shoulder:** Use elbow (7), shoulder (5), hip (11)
- **Right shoulder:** Use elbow (8), shoulder (6), hip (12)

### **4. Ankle Dorsiflexion/Plantarflexion**
- **Left ankle:** Use knee (13), ankle (15), foot/toe (17 if available)
- **Right ankle:** Use knee (14), ankle (16), foot/toe (18 if available)

---

## **How to Implement**

1. **Add angle calculations for each joint of interest using the same `getAngle` utility.**
2. **Compute min, max, avg for each angle array.**
3. **Add to your summary template.**

---

## **Example: Add Hip and Elbow Angles**

```ts
// MoveNet keypoints indices
const indices = {
  leftShoulder: 5,
  rightShoulder: 6,
  leftHip: 11,
  rightHip: 12,
  leftKnee: 13,
  rightKnee: 14,
  leftAnkle: 15,
  rightAnkle: 16,
  leftElbow: 7,
  rightElbow: 8,
  leftWrist: 9,
  rightWrist: 10,
};

// Hip flexion
const leftHipAngles = keypoints.map((pose) => {
  if (!pose || !pose.keypoints) return null;
  const shoulder = pose.keypoints[indices.leftShoulder];
  const hip = pose.keypoints[indices.leftHip];
  const knee = pose.keypoints[indices.leftKnee];
  if (
    shoulder?.score > 0.4 &&
    hip?.score > 0.4 &&
    knee?.score > 0.4
  ) {
    return getAngle(shoulder, hip, knee);
  }
  return null;
});
const leftHipStats = getStats(leftHipAngles);

// Elbow flexion
const leftElbowAngles = keypoints.map((pose) => {
  if (!pose || !pose.keypoints) return null;
  const shoulder = pose.keypoints[indices.leftShoulder];
  const elbow = pose.keypoints[indices.leftElbow];
  const wrist = pose.keypoints[indices.leftWrist];
  if (
    shoulder?.score > 0.4 &&
    elbow?.score > 0.4 &&
    wrist?.score > 0.4
  ) {
    return getAngle(shoulder, elbow, wrist);
  }
  return null;
});
const leftElbowStats = getStats(leftElbowAngles);
```

```ts
Average left hip flexion: ${leftHipStats.avg?.toFixed(1) ?? "N/A"}° (min: ${leftHipStats.min?.toFixed(1) ?? "N/A"}°, max: ${leftHipStats.max?.toFixed(1) ?? "N/A"}°).
```

Absolutely! Here’s a full code sample for your admin upload page that:

- Extracts keypoints from an uploaded video
- Calculates left knee, left hip, and left elbow flexion angles for each frame
- Displays min, max, and average stats for each angle

```tsx
"use client";
import React, { useState, useRef, useEffect } from "react";
import * as poseDetection from "@tensorflow-models/pose-detection";
import "@tensorflow/tfjs-backend-webgl";
import * as tf from "@tensorflow/tfjs-core";
import {
  LineChart,
  Line,
  XAxis,
  YAxis,
  Tooltip,
  ResponsiveContainer,
  Legend,
} from "recharts";

// Utility to calculate angle at point b (in degrees)
function getAngle(a: { x: number; y: number }, b: { x: number; y: number }, c: { x: number; y: number }) {
  const ab = { x: a.x - b.x, y: a.y - b.y };
  const cb = { x: c.x - b.x, y: c.y - b.y };
  const dot = ab.x * cb.x + ab.y * cb.y;
  const magAB = Math.sqrt(ab.x * ab.x + ab.y * ab.y);
  const magCB = Math.sqrt(cb.x * cb.x + cb.y * cb.y);
  const angleRad = Math.acos(dot / (magAB * magCB));
  return (angleRad * 180) / Math.PI;
}

const ADMIN_PASSWORD = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_ADMIN_PASSWORD || "letmein";

export default function AdminUpload() {
  // Security
  const [authorized, setAuthorized] = useState(false);
  const [input, setInput] = useState("");

  // Video/keypoints
  const [videoUrl, setVideoUrl] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [keypoints, setKeypoints] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [processing, setProcessing] = useState(false);
  const [selectedFrame, setSelectedFrame] = useState(0);

  const videoRef = useRef<HTMLVideoElement>(null);
  const fileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const canvasRef = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement>(null);

  // Handle file upload
  const handleUpload = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (file) {
      setVideoUrl(URL.createObjectURL(file));
      setKeypoints([]);
      setSelectedFrame(0);
    }
  };

  // Extract keypoints from video
  const extractKeypoints = async () => {
    if (!videoRef.current) return;
    setProcessing(true);
    await tf.setBackend("webgl");
    await tf.ready();
    const detector = await poseDetection.createDetector(
      poseDetection.SupportedModels.MoveNet,
      { modelType: poseDetection.movenet.modelType.SINGLEPOSE_LIGHTNING }
    );
    const video = videoRef.current;
    const poses: any[] = [];
    video.currentTime = 0;

    // Wait for video metadata to load
    await new Promise((resolve) => {
      if (video.readyState >= 1) resolve(true);
      else video.onloadedmetadata = () => resolve(true);
    });

    // Process every Nth frame (e.g., every 3rd frame for speed)
    const step = 3;
    const frameRate = 30; // Use a default value
    for (let t = 0; t < video.duration; t += step / frameRate) {
      video.currentTime = t;
      await new Promise((resolve) => (video.onseeked = resolve));
      const pose = await detector.estimatePoses(video);
      poses.push(pose[0] || null);
    }
    setKeypoints(poses);
    setProcessing(false);
    setSelectedFrame(0);
  };

  // Download keypoints as JSON
  const downloadKeypoints = () => {
    const blob = new Blob([JSON.stringify(keypoints, null, 2)], { type: "application/json" });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const a = document.createElement("a");
    a.href = url;
    a.download = "keypoints.json";
    a.click();
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  };

  // Draw skeleton for selected frame
  useEffect(() => {
    const canvas = canvasRef.current;
    if (!canvas || !keypoints[selectedFrame]) return;
    const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
    if (!ctx) return;
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

    const pose = keypoints[selectedFrame];
    if (!pose || !pose.keypoints) return;

    // Draw lines
    const adjacentPairs = poseDetection.util.getAdjacentPairs(poseDetection.SupportedModels.MoveNet);
    adjacentPairs.forEach(([i, j]) => {
      const kp1 = pose.keypoints[i];
      const kp2 = pose.keypoints[j];
      if (
        kp1 &&
        kp2 &&
        kp1.score !== undefined &&
        kp2.score !== undefined &&
        kp1.score > 0.4 &&
        kp2.score > 0.4
      ) {
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(kp1.x, kp1.y);
        ctx.lineTo(kp2.x, kp2.y);
        ctx.strokeStyle = "#64FF58";
        ctx.lineWidth = 3;
        ctx.stroke();
      }
    });

    // Draw points
    pose.keypoints.forEach((keypoint: any) => {
      if (keypoint.score && keypoint.score > 0.4) {
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(keypoint.x, keypoint.y, 6, 0, 2 * Math.PI);
        ctx.fillStyle = "#1E3A8A";
        ctx.fill();
      }
    });
  }, [selectedFrame, keypoints]);

  // Set canvas size to match video
  useEffect(() => {
    if (videoRef.current && canvasRef.current) {
      const video = videoRef.current;
      const canvas = canvasRef.current;
      const updateCanvasSize = () => {
        canvas.width = video.videoWidth;
        canvas.height = video.videoHeight;
      };
      video.addEventListener("loadedmetadata", updateCanvasSize);
      return () => video.removeEventListener("loadedmetadata", updateCanvasSize);
    }
  }, [videoUrl]);

  // MoveNet keypoints indices
  const indices = {
    leftShoulder: 5,
    rightShoulder: 6,
    leftHip: 11,
    rightHip: 12,
    leftKnee: 13,
    rightKnee: 14,
    leftAnkle: 15,
    rightAnkle: 16,
    leftElbow: 7,
    rightElbow: 8,
    leftWrist: 9,
    rightWrist: 10,
  };

  // Calculate angles for each frame
  const leftKneeAngles = keypoints.map((pose) => {
    if (!pose || !pose.keypoints) return null;
    const hip = pose.keypoints[indices.leftHip];
    const knee = pose.keypoints[indices.leftKnee];
    const ankle = pose.keypoints[indices.leftAnkle];
    if (
      hip?.score > 0.4 &&
      knee?.score > 0.4 &&
      ankle?.score > 0.4
    ) {
      return getAngle(hip, knee, ankle);
    }
    return null;
  });

  const leftHipAngles = keypoints.map((pose) => {
    if (!pose || !pose.keypoints) return null;
    const shoulder = pose.keypoints[indices.leftShoulder];
    const hip = pose.keypoints[indices.leftHip];
    const knee = pose.keypoints[indices.leftKnee];
    if (
      shoulder?.score > 0.4 &&
      hip?.score > 0.4 &&
      knee?.score > 0.4
    ) {
      return getAngle(shoulder, hip, knee);
    }
    return null;
  });

  const leftElbowAngles = keypoints.map((pose) => {
    if (!pose || !pose.keypoints) return null;
    const shoulder = pose.keypoints[indices.leftShoulder];
    const elbow = pose.keypoints[indices.leftElbow];
    const wrist = pose.keypoints[indices.leftWrist];
    if (
      shoulder?.score > 0.4 &&
      elbow?.score > 0.4 &&
      wrist?.score > 0.4
    ) {
      return getAngle(shoulder, elbow, wrist);
    }
    return null;
  });

  // Stats for each angle
  function getStats(arr: (number | null)[]) {
    const valid = arr.filter((v): v is number => v !== null);
    if (valid.length === 0) return { min: null, max: null, avg: null };
    const min = Math.min(...valid);
    const max = Math.max(...valid);
    const avg = valid.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / valid.length;
    return { min, max, avg };
  }
  const leftKneeStats = getStats(leftKneeAngles);
  const leftHipStats = getStats(leftHipAngles);
  const leftElbowStats = getStats(leftElbowAngles);

  // Chart data
  const angleChartData = leftKneeAngles.map((angle, idx) => ({
    frame: idx + 1,
    leftKnee: angle,
    leftHip: leftHipAngles[idx],
    leftElbow: leftElbowAngles[idx],
  }));

  // Template-based summary
  const summary = `
Average left knee flexion: ${leftKneeStats.avg?.toFixed(1) ?? "N/A"}° (min: ${leftKneeStats.min?.toFixed(1) ?? "N/A"}°, max: ${leftKneeStats.max?.toFixed(1) ?? "N/A"}°).
Average left hip flexion: ${leftHipStats.avg?.toFixed(1) ?? "N/A"}° (min: ${leftHipStats.min?.toFixed(1) ?? "N/A"}°, max: ${leftHipStats.max?.toFixed(1) ?? "N/A"}°).
Average left elbow flexion: ${leftElbowStats.avg?.toFixed(1) ?? "N/A"}° (min: ${leftElbowStats.min?.toFixed(1) ?? "N/A"}°, max: ${leftElbowStats.max?.toFixed(1) ?? "N/A"}°).
`.trim();

  // Basic stats
  const numFrames = keypoints.length;
  const framesWithPerson = keypoints.filter(
    (pose) => pose && pose.keypoints && pose.keypoints.some((kp: any) => kp.score > 0.4)
  ).length;
  const avgConfidence =
    numFrames > 0
      ? (
          keypoints
            .map(
              (pose) =>
                pose &&
                pose.keypoints &&
                pose.keypoints
                  .filter((kp: any) => typeof kp.score === "number")
                  .reduce((sum: number, kp: any) => sum + kp.score, 0) /
                  pose.keypoints.length
            )
            .filter(Boolean)
            .reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / numFrames
        ).toFixed(2)
      : 0;

  // Security
  if (!authorized) {
    return (
      <main className="min-h-screen flex flex-col items-center justify-center bg-onyx-100">
        <div className="bg-onyx-90 p-8 rounded shadow flex flex-col items-center">
          <h1 className="text-xl font-bold mb-4 text-onyx-10">Admin Access</h1>
          <input
            type="password"
            placeholder="Enter admin password"
            value={input}
            onChange={e => setInput(e.target.value)}
            className="mb-4 px-3 py-2 rounded border border-onyx-30 focus:outline-none"
          />
          <button
            className="bg-blue-100 text-white px-4 py-2 rounded font-bold shadow hover:bg-blue-90 transition"
            onClick={() => {
              if (input === ADMIN_PASSWORD) setAuthorized(true);
              else alert("Incorrect password");
            }}
          >
            Enter
          </button>
        </div>
      </main>
    );
  }

  return (
    <main className="min-h-screen bg-onyx-100 flex flex-col items-center px-4 py-8">
      <h1 className="text-2xl font-extrabold text-onyx-10 mb-4">
        Admin: Upload Reference Video
      </h1>
      <button
        className="bg-blue-100 text-white px-4 py-2 rounded font-bold shadow hover:bg-blue-90 transition cursor-pointer mb-4 inline-block"
        onClick={() => fileInputRef.current?.click()}
        type="button"
      >
        Upload Video
      </button>
      <input
        ref={fileInputRef}
        type="file"
        accept="video/*"
        onChange={handleUpload}
        className="hidden"
      />
      {videoUrl && (
        <video
          ref={videoRef}
          src={videoUrl}
          controls
          className="rounded w-[180px] h-[320px] mb-4"
        />
      )}
      {videoUrl && (
        <button
          className="bg-blue-100 text-white px-4 py-2 rounded font-bold shadow-lg hover:bg-blue-90 transition mb-4"
          onClick={extractKeypoints}
          disabled={processing}
        >
          {processing ? "Processing..." : "Extract Keypoints"}
        </button>
      )}
      {keypoints.length > 0 && (
        <>
          <button
            className="bg-green-60 text-white px-4 py-2 rounded font-bold shadow-lg hover:bg-green-70 transition mb-4 border-2 border-green-80"
            onClick={downloadKeypoints}
          >
            ⬇️ Download Keypoints JSON
          </button>
          <div className="mb-4 bg-white rounded p-4 shadow w-full max-w-md">
            <div className="font-bold mb-2">Keypoint Extraction Stats</div>
            <div>Frames processed: {numFrames}</div>
            <div>Frames with detected person: {framesWithPerson}</div>
            <div>Average confidence: {avgConfidence}</div>
            <div className="font-bold mt-4">Left Knee Flexion (°)</div>
            <div>Min: {leftKneeStats.min?.toFixed(1) ?? "N/A"}</div>
            <div>Max: {leftKneeStats.max?.toFixed(1) ?? "N/A"}</div>
            <div>Avg: {leftKneeStats.avg?.toFixed(1) ?? "N/A"}</div>
            <div className="font-bold mt-4">Left Hip Flexion (°)</div>
            <div>Min: {leftHipStats.min?.toFixed(1) ?? "N/A"}</div>
            <div>Max: {leftHipStats.max?.toFixed(1) ?? "N/A"}</div>
            <div>Avg: {leftHipStats.avg?.toFixed(1) ?? "N/A"}</div>
            <div className="font-bold mt-4">Left Elbow Flexion (°)</div>
            <div>Min: {leftElbowStats.min?.toFixed(1) ?? "N/A"}</div>
            <div>Max: {leftElbowStats.max?.toFixed(1) ?? "N/A"}</div>
            <div>Avg: {leftElbowStats.avg?.toFixed(1) ?? "N/A"}</div>
            <div className="font-bold mt-4">Summary</div>
            <div className="mb-2 whitespace-pre-line">{summary}</div>
            <div className="w-full h-48 mb-4">
              <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height="100%">
                <LineChart data={angleChartData}>
                  <XAxis dataKey="frame" />
                  <YAxis domain={[0, 180]} label={{ value: "Angle (°)", angle: -90, position: "insideLeft" }} />
                  <Tooltip />
                  <Legend />
                  <Line type="monotone" dataKey="leftKnee" stroke="#F81818" strokeWidth={2} dot={false} name="Left Knee" />
                  <Line type="monotone" dataKey="leftHip" stroke="#1E3A8A" strokeWidth={2} dot={false} name="Left Hip" />
                  <Line type="monotone" dataKey="leftElbow" stroke="#23D600" strokeWidth={2} dot={false} name="Left Elbow" />
                </LineChart>
              </ResponsiveContainer>
            </div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mt-2">
              <label htmlFor="frame" className="text-xs">Preview frame:</label>
              <input
                id="frame"
                type="range"
                min={0}
                max={numFrames - 1}
                value={selectedFrame}
                onChange={e => setSelectedFrame(Number(e.target.value))}
                className="w-32"
              />
              <span className="text-xs">{selectedFrame + 1}/{numFrames}</span>
            </div>
            <canvas
              ref={canvasRef}
              width={videoRef.current?.videoWidth || 360}
              height={videoRef.current?.videoHeight || 640}
              className="border mt-2 rounded"
              style={{ width: "180px", height: "320px" }}
            />
          </div>
        </>
      )}
    </main>
  );
}
```

```typescriptreact
      elbow?.score > 0.4 &&
      wrist?.score > 0.4
    ) {
      return getAngle(shoulder, elbow, wrist);
    }
    return null;
  });

  // Stats for each angle
  function getStats(arr: (number | null)[]) {
    const valid = arr.filter((v): v is number => v !== null);
    if (valid.length === 0) return { min: null, max: null, avg: null };
    const min = Math.min(...valid);
    const max = Math.max(...valid);
    const avg = valid.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / valid.length;
    return { min, max, avg };
  }
  const leftKneeStats = getStats(leftKneeAngles);
  const leftHipStats = getStats(leftHipAngles);
  const leftElbowStats = getStats(leftElbowAngles);

  // Chart data
  const angleChartData = leftKneeAngles.map((angle, idx) => ({
    frame: idx + 1,
    leftKnee: angle,
    leftHip: leftHipAngles[idx],
    leftElbow: leftElbowAngles[idx],
  }));

  // Template-based summary
  const summary = `
Average left knee flexion: ${leftKneeStats.avg?.toFixed(1) ?? "N/A"}° (min: ${leftKneeStats.min?.toFixed(1) ?? "N/A"}°, max: ${leftKneeStats.max?.toFixed(1) ?? "N/A"}°).
Average left hip flexion: ${leftHipStats.avg?.toFixed(1) ?? "N/A"}° (min: ${leftHipStats.min?.toFixed(1) ?? "N/A"}°, max: ${leftHipStats.max?.toFixed(1) ?? "N/A"}°).
Average left elbow flexion: ${leftElbowStats.avg?.toFixed(1) ?? "N/A"}° (min: ${leftElbowStats.min?.toFixed(1) ?? "N/A"}°, max: ${leftElbowStats.max?.toFixed(1) ?? "N/A"}°).
`.trim();

  // Basic stats
  const numFrames = keypoints.length;
  const framesWithPerson = keypoints.filter(
    (pose) => pose && pose.keypoints && pose.keypoints.some((kp: any) => kp.score > 0.4)
  ).length;
  const avgConfidence =
    numFrames > 0
      ? (
          keypoints
            .map(
              (pose) =>
                pose &&
                pose.keypoints &&
                pose.keypoints
                  .filter((kp: any) => typeof kp.score === "number")
                  .reduce((sum: number, kp: any) => sum + kp.score, 0) /
                  pose.keypoints.length
            )
            .filter(Boolean)
            .reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / numFrames
        ).toFixed(2)
      : 0;

  // Security
  if (!authorized) {
    return (
      <main className="min-h-screen flex flex-col items-center justify-center bg-onyx-100">
        <div className="bg-onyx-90 p-8 rounded shadow flex flex-col items-center">

          <input
            type="password"

          />
          <button
            className="bg-blue-100 text-white px-4 py-2 rounded font-bold shadow hover:bg-blue-90 transition"
            onClick={() => {
              if (input === ADMIN_PASSWORD) setAuthorized(true);
              else alert("Incorrect password");
            }}
          >
            Enter
          </button>
        </div>
      </main>
    );
  }

  return (
    <main className="min-h-screen bg-onyx-100 flex flex-col items-center px-4 py-8">

      >

      <input

          controls

        />
      )}
      {videoUrl && (
        <button
          className="bg-blue-100 text-white px-4 py-2 rounded font-bold shadow-lg hover:bg-blue-90 transition mb-4"
          onClick={extractKeypoints}
          disabled={processing}
        >
          {processing ? "Processing..." : "Extract Keypoints"}
        </button>
      )}
      {keypoints.length > 0 && (
        <>
          <button
            className="bg-green-60 text-white px-4 py-2 rounded font-bold shadow-lg hover:bg-green-70 transition mb-4 border-2 border-green-80"
            onClick={downloadKeypoints}
          >
            ⬇️ Download Keypoints JSON
          </button>
          <div className="mb-4 bg-white rounded p-4 shadow w-full max-w-md">
            <div className="font-bold mb-2">Keypoint Extraction Stats</div>

            <div>Average confidence: {avgConfidence}</div>
            <div className="font-bold mt-4">Left Knee Flexion (°)</div>
            <div>Min: {leftKneeStats.min?.toFixed(1) ?? "N/A"}</div>
            <div>Max: {leftKneeStats.max?.toFixed(1) ?? "N/A"}</div>
```

```tsx
"use client";
import React, { useState, useRef, useEffect } from "react";
import * as poseDetection from "@tensorflow-models/pose-detection";
import "@tensorflow/tfjs-backend-webgl";
import * as tf from "@tensorflow/tfjs-core";
import {
  LineChart,
  Line,
  XAxis,
  YAxis,
  Tooltip,
  ResponsiveContainer,
  Legend,
} from "recharts";

// Utility to calculate angle at point b (in degrees)
function getAngle(a: { x: number; y: number }, b: { x: number; y: number }, c: { x: number; y: number }) {
  const ab = { x: a.x - b.x, y: a.y - b.y };
  const cb = { x: c.x - b.x, y: c.y - b.y };
  const dot = ab.x * cb.x + ab.y * cb.y;
  const magAB = Math.sqrt(ab.x * ab.x + ab.y * ab.y);
  const magCB = Math.sqrt(cb.x * cb.x + cb.y * cb.y);
  const angleRad = Math.acos(dot / (magAB * magCB));
  return (angleRad * 180) / Math.PI;
}

const ADMIN_PASSWORD = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_ADMIN_PASSWORD || "letmein";

export default function AdminUpload() {
  // Security
  const [authorized, setAuthorized] = useState(false);
  const [input, setInput] = useState("");

  // Video/keypoints
  const [videoUrl, setVideoUrl] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [keypoints, setKeypoints] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [processing, setProcessing] = useState(false);
  const [selectedFrame, setSelectedFrame] = useState(0);

  const videoRef = useRef<HTMLVideoElement>(null);
  const fileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const canvasRef = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement>(null);

  // Handle file upload
  const handleUpload = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (file) {
      setVideoUrl(URL.createObjectURL(file));
      setKeypoints([]);
      setSelectedFrame(0);
    }
  };

  // Extract keypoints from video
  const extractKeypoints = async () => {
    if (!videoRef.current) return;
    setProcessing(true);
    await tf.setBackend("webgl");
    await tf.ready();
    const detector = await poseDetection.createDetector(
      poseDetection.SupportedModels.MoveNet,
      { modelType: poseDetection.movenet.modelType.SINGLEPOSE_LIGHTNING }
    );
    const video = videoRef.current;
    const poses: any[] = [];
    video.currentTime = 0;

    // Wait for video metadata to load
    await new Promise((resolve) => {
      if (video.readyState >= 1) resolve(true);
      else video.onloadedmetadata = () => resolve(true);
    });

    // Process every Nth frame (e.g., every 3rd frame for speed)
    const step = 3;
    const frameRate = 30; // Use a default value
    for (let t = 0; t < video.duration; t += step / frameRate) {
      video.currentTime = t;
      await new Promise((resolve) => (video.onseeked = resolve));
      const pose = await detector.estimatePoses(video);
      poses.push(pose[0] || null);
    }
    setKeypoints(poses);
    setProcessing(false);
    setSelectedFrame(0);
  };

  // Download keypoints as JSON
  const downloadKeypoints = () => {
    const blob = new Blob([JSON.stringify(keypoints, null, 2)], { type: "application/json" });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const a = document.createElement("a");
    a.href = url;
    a.download = "keypoints.json";
    a.click();
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  };

  // Draw skeleton for selected frame
  useEffect(() => {
    const canvas = canvasRef.current;
    if (!canvas || !keypoints[selectedFrame]) return;
    const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
    if (!ctx) return;
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

    const pose = keypoints[selectedFrame];
    if (!pose || !pose.keypoints) return;

    // Draw lines
    const adjacentPairs = poseDetection.util.getAdjacentPairs(poseDetection.SupportedModels.MoveNet);
    adjacentPairs.forEach(([i, j]) => {
      const kp1 = pose.keypoints[i];
      const kp2 = pose.keypoints[j];
      if (
        kp1 &&
        kp2 &&
        kp1.score !== undefined &&
        kp2.score !== undefined &&
        kp1.score > 0.4 &&
        kp2.score > 0.4
      ) {
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(kp1.x, kp1.y);
        ctx.lineTo(kp2.x, kp2.y);
        ctx.strokeStyle = "#64FF58";
        ctx.lineWidth = 3;
        ctx.stroke();
      }
    });

    // Draw points
    pose.keypoints.forEach((keypoint: any) => {
      if (keypoint.score && keypoint.score > 0.4) {
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(keypoint.x, keypoint.y, 6, 0, 2 * Math.PI);
        ctx.fillStyle = "#1E3A8A";
        ctx.fill();
      }
    });
  }, [selectedFrame, keypoints]);

  // Set canvas size to match video
  useEffect(() => {
    if (videoRef.current && canvasRef.current) {
      const video = videoRef.current;
      const canvas = canvasRef.current;
      const updateCanvasSize = () => {
        canvas.width = video.videoWidth;
        canvas.height = video.videoHeight;
      };
      video.addEventListener("loadedmetadata", updateCanvasSize);
      return () => video.removeEventListener("loadedmetadata", updateCanvasSize);
    }
  }, [videoUrl]);

  // MoveNet keypoints indices
  const indices = {
    leftShoulder: 5,
    rightShoulder: 6,
    leftHip: 11,
    rightHip: 12,
    leftKnee: 13,
    rightKnee: 14,
    leftAnkle: 15,
    rightAnkle: 16,
    leftElbow: 7,
    rightElbow: 8,
    leftWrist: 9,
    rightWrist: 10,
  };

  // Calculate angles for each frame
  const leftKneeAngles = keypoints.map((pose) => {
    if (!pose || !pose.keypoints) return null;
    const hip = pose.keypoints[indices.leftHip];
    const knee = pose.keypoints[indices.leftKnee];
    const ankle = pose.keypoints[indices.leftAnkle];
    if (
      hip?.score > 0.4 &&
      knee?.score > 0.4 &&
      ankle?.score > 0.4
    ) {
      return getAngle(hip, knee, ankle);
    }
    return null;
  });

  const leftHipAngles = keypoints.map((pose) => {
    if (!pose || !pose.keypoints) return null;
    const shoulder = pose.keypoints[indices.leftShoulder];
    const hip = pose.keypoints[indices.leftHip];
    const knee = pose.keypoints[indices.leftKnee];
    if (
      shoulder?.score > 0.4 &&
      hip?.score > 0.4 &&
      knee?.score > 0.4
    ) {
      return getAngle(shoulder, hip, knee);
    }
    return null;
  });

  const leftElbowAngles = keypoints.map((pose) => {
    if (!pose || !pose.keypoints) return null;
    const shoulder = pose.keypoints[indices.leftShoulder];
    const elbow = pose.keypoints[indices.leftElbow];
    const wrist = pose.keypoints[indices.leftWrist];
    if (
      shoulder?.score > 0.4 &&
      elbow?.score > 0.4 &&
      wrist?.score > 0.4
    ) {
      return getAngle(shoulder, elbow, wrist);
    }
    return null;
  });

  // Stats for each angle
  function getStats(arr: (number | null)[]) {
    const valid = arr.filter((v): v is number => v !== null);
    if (valid.length === 0) return { min: null, max: null, avg: null };
    const min = Math.min(...valid);
    const max = Math.max(...valid);
    const avg = valid.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / valid.length;
    return { min, max, avg };
  }
  const leftKneeStats = getStats(leftKneeAngles);
  const leftHipStats = getStats(leftHipAngles);
  const leftElbowStats = getStats(leftElbowAngles);

  // Chart data
  const angleChartData = leftKneeAngles.map((angle, idx) => ({
    frame: idx + 1,
    leftKnee: angle,
    leftHip: leftHipAngles[idx],
    leftElbow: leftElbowAngles[idx],
  }));

  // Template-based summary
  const summary = `
Average left knee flexion: ${leftKneeStats.avg?.toFixed(1) ?? "N/A"}° (min: ${leftKneeStats.min?.toFixed(1) ?? "N/A"}°, max: ${leftKneeStats.max?.toFixed(1) ?? "N/A"}°).
Average left hip flexion: ${leftHipStats.avg?.toFixed(1) ?? "N/A"}° (min: ${leftHipStats.min?.toFixed(1) ?? "N/A"}°, max: ${leftHipStats.max?.toFixed(1) ?? "N/A"}°).
Average left elbow flexion: ${leftElbowStats.avg?.toFixed(1) ?? "N/A"}° (min: ${leftElbowStats.min?.toFixed(1) ?? "N/A"}°, max: ${leftElbowStats.max?.toFixed(1) ?? "N/A"}°).
`.trim();

  // Basic stats
  const numFrames = keypoints.length;
  const framesWithPerson = keypoints.filter(
    (pose) => pose && pose.keypoints && pose.keypoints.some((kp: any) => kp.score > 0.4)
  ).length;
  const avgConfidence =
    numFrames > 0
      ? (
          keypoints
            .map(
              (pose) =>
                pose &&
                pose.keypoints &&
                pose.keypoints
                  .filter((kp: any) => typeof kp.score === "number")
                  .reduce((sum: number, kp: any) => sum + kp.score, 0) /
                  pose.keypoints.length
            )
            .filter(Boolean)
            .reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / numFrames
        ).toFixed(2)
      : 0;

  // Security
  if (!authorized) {
    return (
      <main className="min-h-screen flex flex-col items-center justify-center bg-onyx-100">
        <div className="bg-onyx-90 p-8 rounded shadow flex flex-col items-center">
          <h1 className="text-xl font-bold mb-4 text-onyx-10">Admin Access</h1>
          <input
            type="password"
            placeholder="Enter admin password"
            value={input}
            onChange={e => setInput(e.target.value)}
            className="mb-4 px-3 py-2 rounded border border-onyx-30 focus:outline-none"
          />
          <button
            className="bg-blue-100 text-white px-4 py-2 rounded font-bold shadow hover:bg-blue-90 transition"
            onClick={() => {
              if (input === ADMIN_PASSWORD) setAuthorized(true);
              else alert("Incorrect password");
            }}
          >
            Enter
          </button>
        </div>
      </main>
    );
  }

  return (
    <main className="min-h-screen bg-onyx-100 flex flex-col items-center px-4 py-8">
      <h1 className="text-2xl font-extrabold text-onyx-10 mb-4">
        Admin: Upload Reference Video
      </h1>
      <button
        className="bg-blue-100 text-white px-4 py-2 rounded font-bold shadow hover:bg-blue-90 transition cursor-pointer mb-4 inline-block"

        Upload Video

        className="hidden"
      />
      {videoUrl && (
        <video
          ref={videoRef}
          src={videoUrl}

        />
      )}
      {videoUrl && (
        <button

          onClick={extractKeypoints}
          disabled={processing}
        >
          {processing ? "Processing..." : "Extract Keypoints"}
        </button>
      )}
      {keypoints.length > 0 && (
        <>
          <button
            className="bg-green-60 text-white px-4 py-2 rounded font-bold shadow-lg hover:bg-green-70 transition mb-4 border-2 border-green-80"
            onClick={downloadKeypoints}
          >
            ⬇️ Download Keypoints JSON
          </button>
          <div className="mb-4 bg-white rounded p-4 shadow w-full max-w-md">
```
