```typescriptreact
"use client";
import React, { useState, useRef, useEffect } from "react";
import * as poseDetection from "@tensorflow-models/pose-detection";
import "@tensorflow/tfjs-backend-webgl";
import * as tf from "@tensorflow/tfjs-core";
import {
  LineChart,
  Line,
  XAxis,
  YAxis,
  Tooltip,
  ResponsiveContainer,
  Legend,
} from "recharts";

// Utility to calculate angle at point b (in degrees)
function getAngle(a: { x: number; y: number }, b: { x: number; y: number }, c: { x: number; y: number }) {
  const ab = { x: a.x - b.x, y: a.y - b.y };
  const cb = { x: c.x - b.x, y: c.y - b.y };
  const dot = ab.x * cb.x + ab.y * cb.y;
  const magAB = Math.sqrt(ab.x * ab.x + ab.y * ab.y);
  const magCB = Math.sqrt(cb.x * cb.x + cb.y * cb.y);
  const angleRad = Math.acos(dot / (magAB * magCB));
  return (angleRad * 180) / Math.PI;
}

const ADMIN_PASSWORD = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_ADMIN_PASSWORD || "letmein";

export default function AdminUpload() {
  // Security
  const [authorized, setAuthorized] = useState(false);
  const [input, setInput] = useState("");

  // Video/keypoints
  const [videoUrl, setVideoUrl] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [keypoints, setKeypoints] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [processing, setProcessing] = useState(false);
  const [selectedFrame, setSelectedFrame] = useState(0);

  const videoRef = useRef<HTMLVideoElement>(null);
  const fileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const canvasRef = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement>(null);

  // Handle file upload
  const handleUpload = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (file) {
      setVideoUrl(URL.createObjectURL(file));
      setKeypoints([]);
      setSelectedFrame(0);
    }
  };

  // Extract keypoints from video
  const extractKeypoints = async () => {
    if (!videoRef.current) return;
    setProcessing(true);
    await tf.setBackend("webgl");
    await tf.ready();
    const detector = await poseDetection.createDetector(
      poseDetection.SupportedModels.MoveNet,
      { modelType: poseDetection.movenet.modelType.SINGLEPOSE_LIGHTNING }
    );
    const video = videoRef.current;
    const poses: any[] = [];
    video.currentTime = 0;

    // Wait for video metadata to load
    await new Promise((resolve) => {
      if (video.readyState >= 1) resolve(true);
      else video.onloadedmetadata = () => resolve(true);
    });

    // Process every Nth frame (e.g., every 3rd frame for speed)
    const step = 3;
    const frameRate = 30; // Use a default value
    for (let t = 0; t < video.duration; t += step / frameRate) {
      video.currentTime = t;
      await new Promise((resolve) => (video.onseeked = resolve));
      const pose = await detector.estimatePoses(video);
      poses.push(pose[0] || null);
    }
    setKeypoints(poses);
    setProcessing(false);
    setSelectedFrame(0);
  };

  // Download keypoints as JSON
  const downloadKeypoints = () => {
    const blob = new Blob([JSON.stringify(keypoints, null, 2)], { type: "application/json" });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const a = document.createElement("a");
    a.href = url;
    a.download = "keypoints.json";
    a.click();
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  };

  // Draw skeleton for selected frame
  useEffect(() => {
    const canvas = canvasRef.current;
    if (!canvas || !keypoints[selectedFrame]) return;
    const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
    if (!ctx) return;
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

    const pose = keypoints[selectedFrame];
    if (!pose || !pose.keypoints) return;

    // Draw lines
    const adjacentPairs = poseDetection.util.getAdjacentPairs(poseDetection.SupportedModels.MoveNet);
    adjacentPairs.forEach(([i, j]) => {
      const kp1 = pose.keypoints[i];
      const kp2 = pose.keypoints[j];
      if (
        kp1 &&
        kp2 &&
        kp1.score !== undefined &&
        kp2.score !== undefined &&
        kp1.score > 0.4 &&
        kp2.score > 0.4
      ) {
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(kp1.x, kp1.y);
        ctx.lineTo(kp2.x, kp2.y);
        ctx.strokeStyle = "#64FF58";
        ctx.lineWidth = 3;
        ctx.stroke();
      }
    });

    // Draw points
    pose.keypoints.forEach((keypoint: any) => {
      if (keypoint.score && keypoint.score > 0.4) {
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(keypoint.x, keypoint.y, 6, 0, 2 * Math.PI);
        ctx.fillStyle = "#1E3A8A";
        ctx.fill();
      }
    });
  }, [selectedFrame, keypoints]);

  // Set canvas size to match video
  useEffect(() => {
    if (videoRef.current && canvasRef.current) {
      const video = videoRef.current;
      const canvas = canvasRef.current;
      const updateCanvasSize = () => {
        canvas.width = video.videoWidth;
        canvas.height = video.videoHeight;
      };
      video.addEventListener("loadedmetadata", updateCanvasSize);
      return () => video.removeEventListener("loadedmetadata", updateCanvasSize);
    }
  }, [videoUrl]);

  // MoveNet keypoints indices
  const indices = {
    leftShoulder: 5,
    rightShoulder: 6,
    leftHip: 11,
    rightHip: 12,
    leftKnee: 13,
    rightKnee: 14,
    leftAnkle: 15,
    rightAnkle: 16,
    leftElbow: 7,
    rightElbow: 8,
    leftWrist: 9,
    rightWrist: 10,
  };

  // Calculate angles for each frame
  const leftKneeAngles = keypoints.map((pose) => {
    if (!pose || !pose.keypoints) return null;
    const hip = pose.keypoints[indices.leftHip];
    const knee = pose.keypoints[indices.leftKnee];
    const ankle = pose.keypoints[indices.leftAnkle];
    if (
      hip?.score > 0.4 &&
      knee?.score > 0.4 &&
      ankle?.score > 0.4
    ) {
      return getAngle(hip, knee, ankle);
    }
    return null;
  });

  const leftHipAngles = keypoints.map((pose) => {
    if (!pose || !pose.keypoints) return null;
    const shoulder = pose.keypoints[indices.leftShoulder];
    const hip = pose.keypoints[indices.leftHip];
    const knee = pose.keypoints[indices.leftKnee];
    if (
      shoulder?.score > 0.4 &&
      hip?.score > 0.4 &&
      knee?.score > 0.4
    ) {
      return getAngle(shoulder, hip, knee);
    }
    return null;
  });

  const leftElbowAngles = keypoints.map((pose) => {
    if (!pose || !pose.keypoints) return null;
    const shoulder = pose.keypoints[indices.leftShoulder];
    const elbow = pose.keypoints[indices.leftElbow];
    const wrist = pose.keypoints[indices.leftWrist];
    if (
      shoulder?.score > 0.4 &&
      elbow?.score > 0.4 &&
      wrist?.score > 0.4
    ) {
      return getAngle(shoulder, elbow, wrist);
    }
    return null;
  });

  // Stats for each angle
  function getStats(arr: (number | null)[]) {
    const valid = arr.filter((v): v is number => v !== null);
    if (valid.length === 0) return { min: null, max: null, avg: null };
    const min = Math.min(...valid);
    const max = Math.max(...valid);
    const avg = valid.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / valid.length;
    return { min, max, avg };
  }
  const leftKneeStats = getStats(leftKneeAngles);
  const leftHipStats = getStats(leftHipAngles);
  const leftElbowStats = getStats(leftElbowAngles);

  // Chart data
  const angleChartData = leftKneeAngles.map((angle, idx) => ({
    frame: idx + 1,
    leftKnee: angle,
    leftHip: leftHipAngles[idx],
    leftElbow: leftElbowAngles[idx],
  }));

  // Template-based summary
  const summary = `
Average left knee flexion: ${leftKneeStats.avg?.toFixed(1) ?? "N/A"}° (min: ${leftKneeStats.min?.toFixed(1) ?? "N/A"}°, max: ${leftKneeStats.max?.toFixed(1) ?? "N/A"}°).
Average left hip flexion: ${leftHipStats.avg?.toFixed(1) ?? "N/A"}° (min: ${leftHipStats.min?.toFixed(1) ?? "N/A"}°, max: ${leftHipStats.max?.toFixed(1) ?? "N/A"}°).
Average left elbow flexion: ${leftElbowStats.avg?.toFixed(1) ?? "N/A"}° (min: ${leftElbowStats.min?.toFixed(1) ?? "N/A"}°, max: ${leftElbowStats.max?.toFixed(1) ?? "N/A"}°).
`.trim();

  // Basic stats
  const numFrames = keypoints.length;
  const framesWithPerson = keypoints.filter(
    (pose) => pose && pose.keypoints && pose.keypoints.some((kp: any) => kp.score > 0.4)
  ).length;
  const avgConfidence =
    numFrames > 0
      ? (
          keypoints
            .map(
              (pose) =>
                pose &&
                pose.keypoints &&
                pose.keypoints
                  .filter((kp: any) => typeof kp.score === "number")
                  .reduce((sum: number, kp: any) => sum + kp.score, 0) /
                  pose.keypoints.length
            )
            .filter(Boolean)
            .reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / numFrames
        ).toFixed(2)
      : 0;

  // Security
  if (!authorized) {
    return (
      <main className="min-h-screen flex flex-col items-center justify-center bg-onyx-100">
        <div className="bg-onyx-90 p-8 rounded shadow flex flex-col items-center">
          <h1 className="text-xl font-bold mb-4 text-onyx-10">Admin Access</h1>
          <input
            type="password"
            placeholder="Enter admin password"
            value={input}
            onChange={e => setInput(e.target.value)}
            className="mb-4 px-3 py-2 rounded border border-onyx-30 focus:outline-none"
          />
          <button
            className="bg-blue-100 text-white px-4 py-2 rounded font-bold shadow hover:bg-blue-90 transition"
            onClick={() => {
              if (input === ADMIN_PASSWORD) setAuthorized(true);
              else alert("Incorrect password");
            }}
          >
            Enter
          </button>
        </div>
      </main>
    );
  }

  return (
    <main className="min-h-screen bg-onyx-100 flex flex-col items-center px-4 py-8">
      <h1 className="text-2xl font-extrabold text-onyx-10 mb-4">
        Admin: Upload Reference Video
      </h1>
      <button
        className="bg-blue-100 text-white px-4 py-2 rounded font-bold shadow hover:bg-blue-90 transition cursor-pointer mb-4 inline-block"
        onClick={() => fileInputRef.current?.click()}
        type="button"
      >
        Upload Video
      </button>
      <input
        ref={fileInputRef}
        type="file"
        accept="video/*"
        onChange={handleUpload}
        className="hidden"
      />
      {videoUrl && (
        <video
          ref={videoRef}
          src={videoUrl}
          controls
          className="rounded w-[180px] h-[320px] mb-4"
        />
      )}
      {videoUrl && (
        <button
          className="bg-blue-100 text-white px-4 py-2 rounded font-bold shadow-lg hover:bg-blue-90 transition mb-4"
          onClick={extractKeypoints}
          disabled={processing}
        >
          {processing ? "Processing..." : "Extract Keypoints"}
        </button>
      )}
      {keypoints.length > 0 && (
        <>
          <button
            className="bg-green-60 text-white px-4 py-2 rounded font-bold shadow-lg hover:bg-green-70 transition mb-4 border-2 border-green-80"
            onClick={downloadKeypoints}
          >
            ⬇️ Download Keypoints JSON
          </button>
          <div className="mb-4 bg-white rounded p-4 shadow w-full max-w-md">
            <div className="font-bold mb-2">Keypoint Extraction Stats</div>
            <div>Frames processed: {numFrames}</div>
            <div>Frames with detected person: {framesWithPerson}</div>
            <div>Average confidence: {avgConfidence}</div>
            <div className="font-bold mt-4">Left Knee Flexion (°)</div>
            <div>Min: {leftKneeStats.min?.toFixed(1) ?? "N/A"}</div>
            <div>Max: {leftKneeStats.max?.toFixed(1) ?? "N/A"}</div>
            <div>Avg: {leftKneeStats.avg?.toFixed(1) ?? "N/A"}</div>
            <div className="font-bold mt-4">Left Hip Flexion (°)</div>
            <div>Min: {leftHipStats.min?.toFixed(1) ?? "N/A"}</div>
            <div>Max: {leftHipStats.max?.toFixed(1) ?? "N/A"}</div>
            <div>Avg: {leftHipStats.avg?.toFixed(1) ?? "N/A"}</div>
            <div className="font-bold mt-4">Left Elbow Flexion (°)</div>
            <div>Min: {leftElbowStats.min?.toFixed(1) ?? "N/A"}</div>
            <div>Max: {leftElbowStats.max?.toFixed(1) ?? "N/A"}</div>
            <div>Avg: {leftElbowStats.avg?.toFixed(1) ?? "N/A"}</div>
            <div className="font-bold mt-4">Summary</div>
            <div className="mb-2 whitespace-pre-line">{summary}</div>
            <div className="w-full h-48 mb-4">
              <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height="100%">
                <LineChart data={angleChartData}>
                  <XAxis dataKey="frame" />
                  <YAxis domain={[0, 180]} label={{ value: "Angle (°)", angle: -90, position: "insideLeft" }} />
                  <Tooltip />
                  <Legend />
                  <Line type="monotone" dataKey="leftKnee" stroke="#F81818" strokeWidth={2} dot={false} name="Left Knee" />
                  <Line type="monotone" dataKey="leftHip" stroke="#1E3A8A" strokeWidth={2} dot={false} name="Left Hip" />
                  <Line type="monotone" dataKey="leftElbow" stroke="#23D600" strokeWidth={2} dot={false} name="Left Elbow" />
                </LineChart>
              </ResponsiveContainer>
            </div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mt-2">
              <label htmlFor="frame" className="text-xs">Preview frame:</label>
              <input
                id="frame"
                type="range"
                min={0}
                max={numFrames - 1}
                value={selectedFrame}
                onChange={e => setSelectedFrame(Number(e.target.value))}
                className="w-32"
              />
              <span className="text-xs">{selectedFrame + 1}/{numFrames}</span>
            </div>
            <canvas
              ref={canvasRef}
              width={videoRef.current?.videoWidth || 360}
              height={videoRef.current?.videoHeight || 640}
              className="border mt-2 rounded"
              style={{ width: "180px", height: "320px" }}
            />
          </div>
        </>
      )}
    </main>
  );
}
```

---

**Cursor**

Great question! You can display and analyze a variety of joints and angles, depending on the exercise and what you want to measure. Here are some of the most common and biomechanically relevant joints/angles you can calculate using MoveNet (or BlazePose, which has even more keypoints):

---

## **Common Joints and Angles for Biomechanical Analysis**

### **Lower Body**
- **Knee flexion/extension** (hip, knee, ankle)
- **Hip flexion/extension** (shoulder, hip, knee)
- **Ankle dorsiflexion/plantarflexion** (knee, ankle, foot/toe if available)

### **Upper Body**
- **Elbow flexion/extension** (shoulder, elbow, wrist)
- **Shoulder abduction/adduction** (elbow, shoulder, hip)
- **Shoulder flexion/extension** (hip, shoulder, elbow)
- **Wrist flexion/extension** (elbow, wrist, hand if available)

### **Trunk/Core**
- **Trunk lean/angle** (shoulder, hip, knee or vertical reference)
- **Pelvic tilt** (left hip, right hip, mid-shoulder)

### **Symmetry**
- **Compare left and right sides** (e.g., left vs. right knee angle)

---

## **MoveNet Keypoint Indices Reference**

| Name           | Index |
|----------------|-------|
| Nose           | 0     |
| Left Eye       | 1     |
| Right Eye      | 2     |
| Left Ear       | 3     |
| Right Ear      | 4     |
| Left Shoulder  | 5     |
| Right Shoulder | 6     |
| Left Elbow     | 7     |
| Right Elbow    | 8     |
| Left Wrist     | 9     |
| Right Wrist    | 10    |
| Left Hip       | 11    |
| Right Hip      | 12    |
| Left Knee      | 13    |
| Right Knee     | 14    |
| Left Ankle     | 15    |
| Right Ankle    | 16    |

---

## **Example Angles You Can Add**

- **Right knee flexion:** right hip (12), right knee (14), right ankle (16)
- **Right hip flexion:** right shoulder (6), right hip (12), right knee (14)
- **Right elbow flexion:** right shoulder (6), right elbow (8), right wrist (10)
- **Right shoulder abduction:** right elbow (8), right shoulder (6), right hip (12)
- **Trunk angle:** left shoulder (5), left hip (11), right hip (12) or vertical

---

## **How to Add More Joints**

Just follow the same pattern as for the left side, but use the right-side indices or other combinations as needed.

**Example for right knee:**
```ts
const rightKneeAngles = keypoints.map((pose) => {
  if (!pose || !pose.keypoints) return null;
  const hip = pose.keypoints[12];
  const knee = pose.keypoints[14];
  const ankle = pose.keypoints[16];
  if (
    hip?.score > 0.4 &&
    knee?.score > 0.4 &&
    ankle?.score > 0.4
  ) {
    return getAngle(hip, knee, ankle);
  }
  return null;
});
```

---

## **Summary Table**

| Angle                    | Keypoints Used (MoveNet)         |
|--------------------------|----------------------------------|
| Left/Right Knee Flexion  | Hip, Knee, Ankle                 |
| Left/Right Hip Flexion   | Shoulder, Hip, Knee              |
| Left/Right Elbow Flexion | Shoulder, Elbow, Wrist           |
| Left/Right Shoulder Abd. | Elbow, Shoulder, Hip             |
| Trunk Angle              | Shoulder, Hip, (vertical ref)    |

---

**You can add as many as you like, and display them in your stats, charts, and summaries!

Absolutely! Here’s a full code sample for your admin upload page that:

- Calculates and displays all the following angles for each frame:
  - Left & right knee flexion
  - Left & right hip flexion
  - Left & right elbow flexion
  - Left & right shoulder abduction
  - Trunk angle (using left shoulder, left hip, right hip)

```tsx
"use client";
import React, { useState, useRef, useEffect } from "react";
import * as poseDetection from "@tensorflow-models/pose-detection";
import "@tensorflow/tfjs-backend-webgl";
import * as tf from "@tensorflow/tfjs-core";
import {
  LineChart,
  Line,
  XAxis,
  YAxis,
  Tooltip,
  ResponsiveContainer,
  Legend,
} from "recharts";

// Utility to calculate angle at point b (in degrees)
function getAngle(a: { x: number; y: number }, b: { x: number; y: number }, c: { x: number; y: number }) {
  const ab = { x: a.x - b.x, y: a.y - b.y };
  const cb = { x: c.x - b.x, y: c.y - b.y };
  const dot = ab.x * cb.x + ab.y * cb.y;
  const magAB = Math.sqrt(ab.x * ab.x + ab.y * ab.y);
  const magCB = Math.sqrt(cb.x * cb.x + cb.y * cb.y);
  const angleRad = Math.acos(dot / (magAB * magCB));
  return (angleRad * 180) / Math.PI;
}

// Utility to calculate trunk angle (shoulder-hip line vs. vertical)
function getTrunkAngle(shoulder: { x: number; y: number }, hip: { x: number; y: number }) {
  // Angle between the vector (shoulder -> hip) and vertical (0, 1)
  const dx = hip.x - shoulder.x;
  const dy = hip.y - shoulder.y;
  const mag = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
  if (mag === 0) return null;
  const cosTheta = dy / mag;
  const angleRad = Math.acos(cosTheta);
  return (angleRad * 180) / Math.PI;
}

const ADMIN_PASSWORD = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_ADMIN_PASSWORD || "letmein";

export default function AdminUpload() {
  // Security
  const [authorized, setAuthorized] = useState(false);
  const [input, setInput] = useState("");

  // Video/keypoints
  const [videoUrl, setVideoUrl] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [keypoints, setKeypoints] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [processing, setProcessing] = useState(false);
  const [selectedFrame, setSelectedFrame] = useState(0);

  const videoRef = useRef<HTMLVideoElement>(null);
  const fileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const canvasRef = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement>(null);

  // Handle file upload
  const handleUpload = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (file) {
      setVideoUrl(URL.createObjectURL(file));
      setKeypoints([]);
      setSelectedFrame(0);
    }
  };

  // Extract keypoints from video
  const extractKeypoints = async () => {
    if (!videoRef.current) return;
    setProcessing(true);
    await tf.setBackend("webgl");
    await tf.ready();
    const detector = await poseDetection.createDetector(
      poseDetection.SupportedModels.MoveNet,
      { modelType: poseDetection.movenet.modelType.SINGLEPOSE_LIGHTNING }
    );
    const video = videoRef.current;
    const poses: any[] = [];
    video.currentTime = 0;

    // Wait for video metadata to load
    await new Promise((resolve) => {
      if (video.readyState >= 1) resolve(true);
      else video.onloadedmetadata = () => resolve(true);
    });

    // Process every Nth frame (e.g., every 3rd frame for speed)
    const step = 3;
    const frameRate = 30; // Use a default value
    for (let t = 0; t < video.duration; t += step / frameRate) {
      video.currentTime = t;
      await new Promise((resolve) => (video.onseeked = resolve));
      const pose = await detector.estimatePoses(video);
      poses.push(pose[0] || null);
    }
    setKeypoints(poses);
    setProcessing(false);
    setSelectedFrame(0);
  };

  // Download keypoints as JSON
  const downloadKeypoints = () => {
    const blob = new Blob([JSON.stringify(keypoints, null, 2)], { type: "application/json" });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const a = document.createElement("a");
    a.href = url;
    a.download = "keypoints.json";
    a.click();
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  };

  // Draw skeleton for selected frame
  useEffect(() => {
    const canvas = canvasRef.current;
    if (!canvas || !keypoints[selectedFrame]) return;
    const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
    if (!ctx) return;
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

    const pose = keypoints[selectedFrame];
    if (!pose || !pose.keypoints) return;

    // Draw lines
    const adjacentPairs = poseDetection.util.getAdjacentPairs(poseDetection.SupportedModels.MoveNet);
    adjacentPairs.forEach(([i, j]) => {
      const kp1 = pose.keypoints[i];
      const kp2 = pose.keypoints[j];
      if (
        kp1 &&
        kp2 &&
        kp1.score !== undefined &&
        kp2.score !== undefined &&
        kp1.score > 0.4 &&
        kp2.score > 0.4
      ) {
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(kp1.x, kp1.y);
        ctx.lineTo(kp2.x, kp2.y);
        ctx.strokeStyle = "#64FF58";
        ctx.lineWidth = 3;
        ctx.stroke();
      }
    });

    // Draw points
    pose.keypoints.forEach((keypoint: any) => {
      if (keypoint.score && keypoint.score > 0.4) {
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(keypoint.x, keypoint.y, 6, 0, 2 * Math.PI);
        ctx.fillStyle = "#1E3A8A";
        ctx.fill();
      }
    });
  }, [selectedFrame, keypoints]);

  // Set canvas size to match video
  useEffect(() => {
    if (videoRef.current && canvasRef.current) {
      const video = videoRef.current;
      const canvas = canvasRef.current;
      const updateCanvasSize = () => {
        canvas.width = video.videoWidth;
        canvas.height = video.videoHeight;
      };
      video.addEventListener("loadedmetadata", updateCanvasSize);
      return () => video.removeEventListener("loadedmetadata", updateCanvasSize);
    }
  }, [videoUrl]);

  // MoveNet keypoints indices
  const indices = {
    leftShoulder: 5,
    rightShoulder: 6,
    leftHip: 11,
    rightHip: 12,
    leftKnee: 13,
    rightKnee: 14,
    leftAnkle: 15,
    rightAnkle: 16,
    leftElbow: 7,
    rightElbow: 8,
    leftWrist: 9,
    rightWrist: 10,
  };

  // Calculate angles for each frame
  const leftKneeAngles = keypoints.map((pose) => {
    if (!pose || !pose.keypoints) return null;
    const hip = pose.keypoints[indices.leftHip];
    const knee = pose.keypoints[indices.leftKnee];
    const ankle = pose.keypoints[indices.leftAnkle];
    if (
      hip?.score > 0.4 &&
      knee?.score > 0.4 &&
      ankle?.score > 0.4
    ) {
      return getAngle(hip, knee, ankle);
    }
    return null;
  });

  const rightKneeAngles = keypoints.map((pose) => {
    if (!pose || !pose.keypoints) return null;
    const hip = pose.keypoints[indices.rightHip];
    const knee = pose.keypoints[indices.rightKnee];
    const ankle = pose.keypoints[indices.rightAnkle];
    if (
      hip?.score > 0.4 &&
      knee?.score > 0.4 &&
      ankle?.score > 0.4
    ) {
      return getAngle(hip, knee, ankle);
    }
    return null;
  });

  const leftHipAngles = keypoints.map((pose) => {
    if (!pose || !pose.keypoints) return null;
    const shoulder = pose.keypoints[indices.leftShoulder];
    const hip = pose.keypoints[indices.leftHip];
    const knee = pose.keypoints[indices.leftKnee];
    if (
      shoulder?.score > 0.4 &&
      hip?.score > 0.4 &&
      knee?.score > 0.4
    ) {
      return getAngle(shoulder, hip, knee);
    }
    return null;
  });

  const rightHipAngles = keypoints.map((pose) => {
    if (!pose || !pose.keypoints) return null;
    const shoulder = pose.keypoints[indices.rightShoulder];
    const hip = pose.keypoints[indices.rightHip];
    const knee = pose.keypoints[indices.rightKnee];
    if (
      shoulder?.score > 0.4 &&
      hip?.score > 0.4 &&
      knee?.score > 0.4
    ) {
      return getAngle(shoulder, hip, knee);
    }
    return null;
  });

  const leftElbowAngles = keypoints.map((pose) => {
    if (!pose || !pose.keypoints) return null;
    const shoulder = pose.keypoints[indices.leftShoulder];
    const elbow = pose.keypoints[indices.leftElbow];
    const wrist = pose.keypoints[indices.leftWrist];
    if (
      shoulder?.score > 0.4 &&
      elbow?.score > 0.4 &&
      wrist?.score > 0.4
    ) {
      return getAngle(shoulder, elbow, wrist);
    }
    return null;
  });

  const rightElbowAngles = keypoints.map((pose) => {
    if (!pose || !pose.keypoints) return null;
    const shoulder = pose.keypoints[indices.rightShoulder];
    const elbow = pose.keypoints[indices.rightElbow];
    const wrist = pose.keypoints[indices.rightWrist];
    if (
      shoulder?.score > 0.4 &&
      elbow?.score > 0.4 &&
      wrist?.score > 0.4
    ) {
      return getAngle(shoulder, elbow, wrist);
    }
    return null;
  });

  const leftShoulderAbdAngles = keypoints.map((pose) => {
    if (!pose || !pose.keypoints) return null;
    const elbow = pose.keypoints[indices.leftElbow];
    const shoulder = pose.keypoints[indices.leftShoulder];
    const hip = pose.keypoints[indices.leftHip];
    if (
      elbow?.score > 0.4 &&
      shoulder?.score > 0.4 &&
      hip?.score > 0.4
    ) {
      return getAngle(elbow, shoulder, hip);
    }
    return null;
  });

  const rightShoulderAbdAngles = keypoints.map((pose) => {
    if (!pose || !pose.keypoints) return null;
    const elbow = pose.keypoints[indices.rightElbow];
    const shoulder = pose.keypoints[indices.rightShoulder];
    const hip = pose.keypoints[indices.rightHip];
    if (
      elbow?.score > 0.4 &&
      shoulder?.score > 0.4 &&
      hip?.score > 0.4
    ) {
      return getAngle(elbow, shoulder, hip);
    }
    return null;
  });

  const trunkAngles = keypoints.map((pose) => {
    if (!pose || !pose.keypoints) return null;
    const leftShoulder = pose.keypoints[indices.leftShoulder];
    const leftHip = pose.keypoints[indices.leftHip];
    const rightHip = pose.keypoints[indices.rightHip];
    if (
      leftShoulder?.score > 0.4 &&
      leftHip?.score > 0.4 &&
      rightHip?.score > 0.4
    ) {
      // Use left shoulder and midpoint of hips
      const midHip = {
        x: (leftHip.x + rightHip.x) / 2,
        y: (leftHip.y + rightHip.y) / 2,
      };
      return getTrunkAngle(leftShoulder, midHip);
    }
    return null;
  });

  // Stats for each angle
  function getStats(arr: (number | null)[]) {
    const valid = arr.filter((v): v is number => v !== null);
    if (valid.length === 0) return { min: null, max: null, avg: null };
    const min = Math.min(...valid);
    const max = Math.max(...valid);
    const avg = valid.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / valid.length;
    return { min, max, avg };
  }
  const leftKneeStats = getStats(leftKneeAngles);
  const rightKneeStats = getStats(rightKneeAngles);
  const leftHipStats = getStats(leftHipAngles);
  const rightHipStats = getStats(rightHipAngles);
  const leftElbowStats = getStats(leftElbowAngles);
  const rightElbowStats = getStats(rightElbowAngles);
  const leftShoulderAbdStats = getStats(leftShoulderAbdAngles);
  const rightShoulderAbdStats = getStats(rightShoulderAbdAngles);
  const trunkStats = getStats(trunkAngles);

  // Chart data
  const angleChartData = leftKneeAngles.map((_, idx) => ({
    frame: idx + 1,
    leftKnee: leftKneeAngles[idx],
    rightKnee: rightKneeAngles[idx],
    leftHip: leftHipAngles[idx],
    rightHip: rightHipAngles[idx],
    leftElbow: leftElbowAngles[idx],
    rightElbow: rightElbowAngles[idx],
    leftShoulderAbd: leftShoulderAbdAngles[idx],
    rightShoulderAbd: rightShoulderAbdAngles[idx],
    trunk: trunkAngles[idx],
  }));

  // Template-based summary
  const summary = `
Left knee flexion: avg ${leftKneeStats.avg?.toFixed(1) ?? "N/A"}° (min: ${leftKneeStats.min?.toFixed(1) ?? "N/A"}°, max: ${leftKneeStats.max?.toFixed(1) ?? "N/A"}°)
Right knee flexion: avg ${rightKneeStats.avg?.toFixed(1) ?? "N/A"}° (min: ${rightKneeStats.min?.toFixed(1) ?? "N/A"}°, max: ${rightKneeStats.max?.toFixed(1) ?? "N/A"}°)
Left hip flexion: avg ${leftHipStats.avg?.toFixed(1) ?? "N/A"}° (min: ${leftHipStats.min?.toFixed(1) ?? "N/A"}°, max: ${leftHipStats.max?.toFixed(1) ?? "N/A"}°)
Right hip flexion: avg ${rightHipStats.avg?.toFixed(1) ?? "N/A"}° (min: ${rightHipStats.min?.toFixed(1) ?? "N/A"}°, max: ${rightHipStats.max?.toFixed(1) ?? "N/A"}°)
Left elbow flexion: avg ${leftElbowStats.avg?.toFixed(1) ?? "N/A"}° (min: ${leftElbowStats.min?.toFixed(1) ?? "N/A"}°, max: ${leftElbowStats.max?.toFixed(1) ?? "N/A"}°)
Right elbow flexion: avg ${rightElbowStats.avg?.toFixed(1) ?? "N/A"}° (min: ${rightElbowStats.min?.toFixed(1) ?? "N/A"}°, max: ${rightElbowStats.max?.toFixed(1) ?? "N/A"}°)
Left shoulder abduction: avg ${leftShoulderAbdStats.avg?.toFixed(1) ?? "N/A"}° (min: ${leftShoulderAbdStats.min?.toFixed(1) ?? "N/A"}°, max: ${leftShoulderAbdStats.max?.toFixed(1) ?? "N/A"}°)
Right shoulder abduction: avg ${rightShoulderAbdStats.avg?.toFixed(1) ?? "N/A"}° (min: ${rightShoulderAbdStats.min?.toFixed(1) ?? "N/A"}°, max: ${rightShoulderAbdStats.max?.toFixed(1) ?? "N/A"}°)
Trunk angle: avg ${trunkStats.avg?.toFixed(1) ?? "N/A"}° (min: ${trunkStats.min?.toFixed(1) ?? "N/A"}°, max: ${trunkStats.max?.toFixed(1) ?? "N/A"}°)
`.trim();

  // Basic stats
  const numFrames = keypoints.length;
  const framesWithPerson = keypoints.filter(
    (pose) => pose && pose.keypoints && pose.keypoints.some((kp: any) => kp.score > 0.4)
  ).length;
  const avgConfidence =
    numFrames > 0
      ? (
          keypoints
            .map(
              (pose) =>
                pose &&
                pose.keypoints &&
                pose.keypoints
                  .filter((kp: any) => typeof kp.score === "number")
                  .reduce((sum: number, kp: any) => sum + kp.score, 0) /
                  pose.keypoints.length
            )
            .filter(Boolean)
            .reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / numFrames
        ).toFixed(2)
      : 0;

  // Security
  if (!authorized) {
    return (
      <main className="min-h-screen flex flex-col items-center justify-center bg-onyx-100">
        <div className="bg-onyx-90 p-8 rounded shadow flex flex-col items-center">
          <h1 className="text-xl font-bold mb-4 text-onyx-10">Admin Access</h1>
          <input
            type="password"
            placeholder="Enter admin password"
            value={input}
            onChange={e => setInput(e.target.value)}
            className="mb-4 px-3 py-2 rounded border border-onyx-30 focus:outline-none"
          />
          <button
            className="bg-blue-100 text-white px-4 py-2 rounded font-bold shadow hover:bg-blue-90 transition"
            onClick={() => {
              if (input === ADMIN_PASSWORD) setAuthorized(true);
              else alert("Incorrect password");
            }}
          >
            Enter
          </button>
        </div>
      </main>
    );
  }

  return (
    <main className="min-h-screen bg-onyx-100 flex flex-col items-center px-4 py-8">
      <h1 className="text-2xl font-extrabold text-onyx-10 mb-4">
        Admin: Upload Reference Video
      </h1>
      <button
        className="bg-blue-100 text-white px-4 py-2 rounded font-bold shadow hover:bg-blue-90 transition cursor-pointer mb-4 inline-block"
        onClick={() => fileInputRef.current?.click()}
        type="button"
      >

      </button>
      <input
        ref={fileInputRef}
        type="file"
        accept="video/*"
        onChange={handleUpload}

      />

        <video
          ref={videoRef}
          src={videoUrl}
          controls
          className="rounded w-[180px] h-[320px] mb-4"
        />
      )}
      {videoUrl && (
        <button
          className="bg-blue-100 text-white px-4 py-2 rounded font-bold shadow-lg hover:bg-blue-90 transition mb-4"
          onClick={extractKeypoints}
          disabled={processing}
        >
          {processing ? "Processing..." : "Extract Keypoints"}
        </button>
      )}
      {keypoints.length > 0 && (
        <>
          <button
            className="bg-green-60 text-white px-4 py-2 rounded font-bold shadow-lg hover:bg-green-70 transition mb-4 border-2 border-green-80"
            onClick={downloadKeypoints}
          >
            ⬇️ Download Keypoints JSON
          </button>
          <div className="mb-4 bg-white rounded p-4 shadow w-full max-w-md">
            <div className="font-bold mb-2">Keypoint Extraction Stats</div>
            <div>Frames processed: {numFrames}</div>
            <div>Frames with detected person: {framesWithPerson}</div>
            <div>Average confidence: {avgConfidence}</div>
            <div className="font-bold mt-4">Summary</div>
            <div className="mb-2 whitespace-pre-line">{summary}</div>
            <div className="w-full h-64 mb-4">
              <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height="100%">
                <LineChart data={angleChartData}>
                  <XAxis dataKey="frame" />
                  <YAxis domain={[0, 180]} label={{ value: "Angle (°)", angle: -90, position: "insideLeft" }} />
                  <Tooltip />
                  <Legend />
                  <Line type="monotone" dataKey="leftKnee" stroke="#F81818" strokeWidth={2} dot={false} name="Left Knee" />
                  <Line type="monotone" dataKey="rightKnee" stroke="#B60E0E" strokeWidth={2} dot={false} name="Right Knee" />
                  <Line type="monotone" dataKey="leftHip" stroke="#1E3A8A" strokeWidth={2} dot={false} name="Left Hip" />
                  <Line type="monotone" dataKey="rightHip" stroke="#2563EB" strokeWidth={2} dot={false} name="Right Hip" />
                  <Line type="monotone" dataKey="leftElbow" stroke="#23D600" strokeWidth={2} dot={false} name="Left Elbow" />
                  <Line type="monotone" dataKey="rightElbow" stroke="#085900" strokeWidth={2} dot={false} name="Right Elbow" />
                  <Line type="monotone" dataKey="leftShoulderAbd" stroke="#FFC300" strokeWidth={2} dot={false} name="Left Shoulder Abd." />
                  <Line type="monotone" dataKey="rightShoulderAbd" stroke="#FF5733" strokeWidth={2} dot={false} name="Right Shoulder Abd." />
                  <Line type="monotone" dataKey="trunk" stroke="#9b9a5a" strokeWidth={2} dot={false} name="Trunk Angle" />
                </LineChart>
              </ResponsiveContainer>
            </div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mt-2">
              <label htmlFor="frame" className="text-xs">Preview frame:</label>
              <input
                id="frame"
                type="range"
                min={0}
                max={numFrames - 1}
                value={selectedFrame}
                onChange={e => setSelectedFrame(Number(e.target.value))}
                className="w-32"
              />
              <span className="text-xs">{selectedFrame + 1}/{numFrames}</span>
            </div>
            <canvas
              ref={canvasRef}
              width={videoRef.current?.videoWidth || 360}
              height={videoRef.current?.videoHeight || 640}
              className="border mt-2 rounded"
              style={{ width: "180px", height: "320px" }}
            />
          </div>
        </>
      )}
    </main>
  );
}
```

```typescriptreact
"use client";
import React, { useState, useRef, useEffect } from "react";
import * as poseDetection from "@tensorflow-models/pose-detection";
import "@tensorflow/tfjs-backend-webgl";
import * as tf from "@tensorflow/tfjs-core";
import {
  LineChart,
  Line,
  XAxis,
  YAxis,
  Tooltip,
  ResponsiveContainer,
  Legend,
} from "recharts";

// Utility to calculate angle at point b (in degrees)
function getAngle(a: { x: number; y: number }, b: { x: number; y: number }, c: { x: number; y: number }) {
  const ab = { x: a.x - b.x, y: a.y - b.y };
  const cb = { x: c.x - b.x, y: c.y - b.y };
  const dot = ab.x * cb.x + ab.y * cb.y;
  const magAB = Math.sqrt(ab.x * ab.x + ab.y * ab.y);
  const magCB = Math.sqrt(cb.x * cb.x + cb.y * cb.y);
  const angleRad = Math.acos(dot / (magAB * magCB));
  return (angleRad * 180) / Math.PI;
}

// Utility to calculate trunk angle (shoulder-hip line vs. vertical)
function getTrunkAngle(shoulder: { x: number; y: number }, hip: { x: number; y: number }) {
  // Angle between the vector (shoulder -> hip) and vertical (0, 1)
  const dx = hip.x - shoulder.x;
  const dy = hip.y - shoulder.y;
  const mag = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
  if (mag === 0) return null;
  const cosTheta = dy / mag;
  const angleRad = Math.acos(cosTheta);
  return (angleRad * 180) / Math.PI;
}

const ADMIN_PASSWORD = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_ADMIN_PASSWORD || "letmein";

export default function AdminUpload() {
  // Security
  const [authorized, setAuthorized] = useState(false);
  const [input, setInput] = useState("");

  // Video/keypoints
  const [videoUrl, setVideoUrl] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [keypoints, setKeypoints] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [processing, setProcessing] = useState(false);
  const [selectedFrame, setSelectedFrame] = useState(0);

  const videoRef = useRef<HTMLVideoElement>(null);
  const fileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const canvasRef = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement>(null);

  // Handle file upload
  const handleUpload = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (file) {
      setVideoUrl(URL.createObjectURL(file));
      setKeypoints([]);
      setSelectedFrame(0);
    }
  };

  // Extract keypoints from video
  const extractKeypoints = async () => {
    if (!videoRef.current) return;
    setProcessing(true);
    await tf.setBackend("webgl");
    await tf.ready();
    const detector = await poseDetection.createDetector(
      poseDetection.SupportedModels.MoveNet,
      { modelType: poseDetection.movenet.modelType.SINGLEPOSE_LIGHTNING }
    );
    const video = videoRef.current;
    const poses: any[] = [];
    video.currentTime = 0;

    // Wait for video metadata to load
    await new Promise((resolve) => {
      if (video.readyState >= 1) resolve(true);
      else video.onloadedmetadata = () => resolve(true);
    });

    // Process every Nth frame (e.g., every 3rd frame for speed)
    const step = 3;
    const frameRate = 30; // Use a default value
    for (let t = 0; t < video.duration; t += step / frameRate) {
      video.currentTime = t;
      await new Promise((resolve) => (video.onseeked = resolve));
      const pose = await detector.estimatePoses(video);
      poses.push(pose[0] || null);
    }
    setKeypoints(poses);
    setProcessing(false);
    setSelectedFrame(0);
  };

  // Download keypoints as JSON
  const downloadKeypoints = () => {
    const blob = new Blob([JSON.stringify(keypoints, null, 2)], { type: "application/json" });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const a = document.createElement("a");
    a.href = url;
    a.download = "keypoints.json";
    a.click();
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  };

  // Draw skeleton for selected frame
  useEffect(() => {
    const canvas = canvasRef.current;
    if (!canvas || !keypoints[selectedFrame]) return;
    const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
    if (!ctx) return;
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

    const pose = keypoints[selectedFrame];
    if (!pose || !pose.keypoints) return;

    // Draw lines
    const adjacentPairs = poseDetection.util.getAdjacentPairs(poseDetection.SupportedModels.MoveNet);
    adjacentPairs.forEach(([i, j]) => {
      const kp1 = pose.keypoints[i];
      const kp2 = pose.keypoints[j];
      if (
        kp1 &&
        kp2 &&
        kp1.score !== undefined &&
        kp2.score !== undefined &&
        kp1.score > 0.4 &&
        kp2.score > 0.4
      ) {
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(kp1.x, kp1.y);
        ctx.lineTo(kp2.x, kp2.y);
        ctx.strokeStyle = "#64FF58";
        ctx.lineWidth = 3;
        ctx.stroke();
      }
    });

    // Draw points
    pose.keypoints.forEach((keypoint: any) => {
      if (keypoint.score && keypoint.score > 0.4) {
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(keypoint.x, keypoint.y, 6, 0, 2 * Math.PI);
        ctx.fillStyle = "#1E3A8A";
        ctx.fill();
      }
    });
  }, [selectedFrame, keypoints]);

  // Set canvas size to match video
  useEffect(() => {

  const leftHipAngles = keypoints.map((pose) => {

    const shoulder = pose.keypoints[indices.leftShoulder];
    const hip = pose.keypoints[indices.leftHip];
    const knee = pose.keypoints[indices.leftKnee];
    if (
      shoulder?.score > 0.4 &&
      hip?.score > 0.4 &&
      knee?.score > 0.4

  const rightHipAngles = keypoints.map((pose) => {

    const shoulder = pose.keypoints[indices.rightShoulder];
    const hip = pose.keypoints[indices.rightHip];
    const knee = pose.keypoints[indices.rightKnee];
    if (
      shoulder?.score > 0.4 &&
      hip?.score > 0.4 &&
      knee?.score > 0.4
    ) {
      return getAngle(shoulder, hip, knee);
    }
    return null;

  const leftElbowAngles = keypoints.map((pose) => {
    if (!pose || !pose.keypoints) return null;
    const shoulder = pose.keypoints[indices.leftShoulder];
    const elbow = pose.keypoints[indices.leftElbow];
    const wrist = pose.keypoints[indices.leftWrist];
    if (
      shoulder?.score > 0.4 &&
      elbow?.score > 0.4 &&
      wrist?.score > 0.4
    ) {
      return getAngle(shoulder, elbow, wrist);
    }
    return null;
  });

  const rightElbowAngles = keypoints.map((pose) => {
    if (!pose || !pose.keypoints) return null;
    const shoulder = pose.keypoints[indices.rightShoulder];
    const elbow = pose.keypoints[indices.rightElbow];
    const wrist = pose.keypoints[indices.rightWrist];
    if (
      shoulder?.score > 0.4 &&
      elbow?.score > 0.4 &&

    ) {

    }
    return null;
  });

  const leftShoulderAbdAngles = keypoints.map((pose) => {
    if (!pose || !pose.keypoints) return null;
    const elbow = pose.keypoints[indices.leftElbow];
    const shoulder = pose.keypoints[indices.leftShoulder];
    const hip = pose.keypoints[indices.leftHip];
    if (
      elbow?.score > 0.4 &&
      shoulder?.score > 0.4 &&
      hip?.score > 0.4
    ) {
      return getAngle(elbow, shoulder, hip);
    }
    return null;
  });

  const rightShoulderAbdAngles = keypoints.map((pose) => {
    if (!pose || !pose.keypoints) return null;
    const elbow = pose.keypoints[indices.rightElbow];
    const shoulder = pose.keypoints[indices.rightShoulder];
    const hip = pose.keypoints[indices.rightHip];
    if (
      elbow?.score > 0.4 &&
      shoulder?.score > 0.4 &&

    ) {

  const trunkAngles = keypoints.map((pose) => {

    const leftShoulder = pose.keypoints[indices.leftShoulder];

    const rightHip = pose.keypoints[indices.rightHip];
    if (
      leftShoulder?.score > 0.4 &&
      leftHip?.score > 0.4 &&

    ) {
      // Use left shoulder and midpoint of hips
      const midHip = {

        y: (leftHip.y + rightHip.y) / 2,
      };
      return getTrunkAngle(leftShoulder, midHip);

  });

  // Stats for each angle
  function getStats(arr: (number | null)[]) {

    if (valid.length === 0) return { min: null, max: null, avg: null };
    const min = Math.min(...valid);
    const max = Math.max(...valid);

  }
  const leftKneeStats = getStats(leftKneeAngles);
  const rightKneeStats = getStats(rightKneeAngles);
  const leftHipStats = getStats(leftHipAngles);
  const rightHipStats = getStats(rightHipAngles);
  const leftElbowStats = getStats(leftElbowAngles);
  const rightElbowStats = getStats(rightElbowAngles);
  const leftShoulderAbdStats = getStats(leftShoulderAbdAngles);
  const rightShoulderAbdStats = getStats(rightShoulderAbdAngles);
  const trunkStats = getStats(trunkAngles);

  // Chart data
  const angleChartData = leftKneeAngles.map((_, idx) => ({

    rightKnee: rightKneeAngles[idx],
    leftHip: leftHipAngles[idx],
```

```tsx
"use client";
import React, { useState, useRef, useEffect } from "react";
import * as poseDetection from "@tensorflow-models/pose-detection";
import "@tensorflow/tfjs-backend-webgl";
import * as tf from "@tensorflow/tfjs-core";
import {
  LineChart,
  Line,
  XAxis,
  YAxis,
  Tooltip,
  ResponsiveContainer,
  Legend,
} from "recharts";

// Utility to calculate angle at point b (in degrees)
function getAngle(a: { x: number; y: number }, b: { x: number; y: number }, c: { x: number; y: number }) {
  const ab = { x: a.x - b.x, y: a.y - b.y };
  const cb = { x: c.x - b.x, y: c.y - b.y };
  const dot = ab.x * cb.x + ab.y * cb.y;
  const magAB = Math.sqrt(ab.x * ab.x + ab.y * ab.y);
  const magCB = Math.sqrt(cb.x * cb.x + cb.y * cb.y);
  const angleRad = Math.acos(dot / (magAB * magCB));
  return (angleRad * 180) / Math.PI;
}

// Utility to calculate trunk angle (shoulder-hip line vs. vertical)
function getTrunkAngle(shoulder: { x: number; y: number }, hip: { x: number; y: number }) {
  const dx = hip.x - shoulder.x;
  const dy = hip.y - shoulder.y;
  const mag = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
  if (mag === 0) return null;
  const cosTheta = dy / mag;
  const angleRad = Math.acos(cosTheta);
  return (angleRad * 180) / Math.PI;
}

const ADMIN_PASSWORD = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_ADMIN_PASSWORD || "letmein";

export default function AdminUpload() {
  // Security
  const [authorized, setAuthorized] = useState(false);
  const [input, setInput] = useState("");

  // Video/keypoints
  const [videoUrl, setVideoUrl] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [keypoints, setKeypoints] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [processing, setProcessing] = useState(false);
  const [selectedFrame, setSelectedFrame] = useState(0);

  const videoRef = useRef<HTMLVideoElement>(null);
  const fileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const canvasRef = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement>(null);

  // Handle file upload
  const handleUpload = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (file) {
      setVideoUrl(URL.createObjectURL(file));
      setKeypoints([]);
      setSelectedFrame(0);
    }
  };

  // Extract keypoints from video
  const extractKeypoints = async () => {
    if (!videoRef.current) return;
    setProcessing(true);
    await tf.setBackend("webgl");
    await tf.ready();
    const detector = await poseDetection.createDetector(
      poseDetection.SupportedModels.MoveNet,
      { modelType: poseDetection.movenet.modelType.SINGLEPOSE_LIGHTNING }
    );
    const video = videoRef.current;
    const poses: any[] = [];
    video.currentTime = 0;

    await new Promise((resolve) => {
      if (video.readyState >= 1) resolve(true);
      else video.onloadedmetadata = () => resolve(true);
    });

    const step = 3;
    const frameRate = 30;
    for (let t = 0; t < video.duration; t += step / frameRate) {
      video.currentTime = t;
      await new Promise((resolve) => (video.onseeked = resolve));
      const pose = await detector.estimatePoses(video);
      poses.push(pose[0] || null);
    }
    setKeypoints(poses);
    setProcessing(false);
    setSelectedFrame(0);
  };

  // Download keypoints as JSON
  const downloadKeypoints = () => {
    const blob = new Blob([JSON.stringify(keypoints, null, 2)], { type: "application/json" });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const a = document.createElement("a");
    a.href = url;
    a.download = "keypoints.json";
    a.click();
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  };

  // Draw skeleton for selected frame
  useEffect(() => {
    const canvas = canvasRef.current;
    if (!canvas || !keypoints[selectedFrame]) return;
    const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
    if (!ctx) return;
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

    const pose = keypoints[selectedFrame];
    if (!pose || !pose.keypoints) return;

    const adjacentPairs = poseDetection.util.getAdjacentPairs(poseDetection.SupportedModels.MoveNet);
    adjacentPairs.forEach(([i, j]) => {

      const kp2 = pose.keypoints[j];
      if (

        kp1.score > 0.4 &&

        ctx.strokeStyle = "#64FF58";
        ctx.lineWidth = 3;
        ctx.stroke();
      }
    });

    pose.keypoints.forEach((keypoint: any) => {
      if (keypoint.score && keypoint.score > 0.4) {

        ctx.arc(keypoint.x, keypoint.y, 6, 0, 2 * Math.PI);

      )}
      {keypoints.length > 0 && (
        <>
          <button
            className="bg-green-60 text-white px-4 py-2 rounded font-bold shadow-lg hover:bg-green-70 transition mb-4 border-2 border-green-80"
            onClick={downloadKeypoints}
          >
            ⬇️ Download Keypoints JSON
          </button>
          <div className="mb-4 bg-white rounded p-4 shadow w-full max-w-md">
            <div className="font-bold mb-2">Keypoint Extraction Stats</div>
            <div>Frames processed: {numFrames}</div>
            <div>Frames with detected person: {framesWithPerson}</div>
            <div>Average confidence: {avgConfidence}</div>
            <div className="font-bold mt-4">Summary</div>
            <div className="mb-2 whitespace-pre-line">{summary}</div>
            <div className="w-full h-64 mb-4">
              <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height="100%">
                <LineChart data={angleChartData}>
                  <XAxis dataKey="frame" />
                  <YAxis domain={[0, 180]} label={{ value: "Angle (°)", angle: -90, position: "insideLeft" }} />
                  <Tooltip />
                  <Legend />
                  <Line type="monotone" dataKey="leftKnee" stroke="#F81818" strokeWidth={2} dot={false} name="Left Knee" />
                  <Line type="monotone" dataKey="rightKnee" stroke="#B60E0E" strokeWidth={2} dot={false} name="Right Knee" />
                  <Line type="monotone" dataKey="leftHip" stroke="#1E3A8A" strokeWidth={2} dot={false} name="Left Hip" />
                  <Line type="monotone" dataKey="rightHip" stroke="#2563EB" strokeWidth={2} dot={false} name="Right Hip" />
                  <Line type="monotone" dataKey="leftElbow" stroke="#23D600" strokeWidth={2} dot={false} name="Left Elbow" />
                  <Line type="monotone" dataKey="rightElbow" stroke="#085900" strokeWidth={2} dot={false} name="Right Elbow" />
                  <Line type="monotone" dataKey="leftShoulderAbd" stroke="#FFC300" strokeWidth={2} dot={false} name="Left Shoulder Abd." />
                  <Line type="monotone" dataKey="rightShoulderAbd" stroke="#FF5733" strokeWidth={2} dot={false} name="Right Shoulder Abd." />
                  <Line type="monotone" dataKey="trunk" stroke="#9b9a5a" strokeWidth={2} dot={false} name="Trunk Angle" />
                </LineChart>
              </ResponsiveContainer>
            </div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mt-2">
              <label htmlFor="frame" className="text-xs">Preview frame:</label>
              <input
                id="frame"
                type="range"
                min={0}
                max={numFrames - 1}
                value={selectedFrame}
                onChange={e => setSelectedFrame(Number(e.target.value))}
                className="w-32"
              />
              <span className="text-xs">{selectedFrame + 1}/{numFrames}</span>
            </div>
            <canvas
              ref={canvasRef}
              width={videoRef.current?.videoWidth || 360}
              height={videoRef.current?.videoHeight || 640}
              className="border mt-2 rounded"
              style={{ width: "180px", height: "320px" }}
            />
          </div>
        </>
      )}
    </main>
  );
}
```

```typescriptreact
"use client";
import React, { useState, useRef, useEffect } from "react";
import * as poseDetection from "@tensorflow-models/pose-detection";
import "@tensorflow/tfjs-backend-webgl";
import * as tf from "@tensorflow/tfjs-core";
import {
  LineChart,
  Line,
  XAxis,
  YAxis,
  Tooltip,
  ResponsiveContainer,
  Legend,
} from "recharts";

// Utility to calculate angle at point b (in degrees)
function getAngle(a: { x: number; y: number }, b: { x: number; y: number }, c: { x: number; y: number }) {
  const ab = { x: a.x - b.x, y: a.y - b.y };
  const cb = { x: c.x - b.x, y: c.y - b.y };
  const dot = ab.x * cb.x + ab.y * cb.y;
  const magAB = Math.sqrt(ab.x * ab.x + ab.y * ab.y);
  const magCB = Math.sqrt(cb.x * cb.x + cb.y * cb.y);
  const angleRad = Math.acos(dot / (magAB * magCB));
  return (angleRad * 180) / Math.PI;
}

// Utility to calculate trunk angle (shoulder-hip line vs. vertical)
function getTrunkAngle(shoulder: { x: number; y: number }, hip: { x: number; y: number }) {
  const dx = hip.x - shoulder.x;
  const dy = hip.y - shoulder.y;
  const mag = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
  if (mag === 0) return null;
  const cosTheta = dy / mag;
  const angleRad = Math.acos(cosTheta);
  return (angleRad * 180) / Math.PI;
}

const ADMIN_PASSWORD = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_ADMIN_PASSWORD || "letmein";

export default function AdminUpload() {
  // Security
  const [authorized, setAuthorized] = useState(false);
  const [input, setInput] = useState("");

  // Video/keypoints
  const [videoUrl, setVideoUrl] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [keypoints, setKeypoints] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [processing, setProcessing] = useState(false);
  const [selectedFrame, setSelectedFrame] = useState(0);

  const videoRef = useRef<HTMLVideoElement>(null);
  const fileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const canvasRef = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement>(null);

  // Handle file upload
  const handleUpload = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (file) {
      setVideoUrl(URL.createObjectURL(file));
      setKeypoints([]);
      setSelectedFrame(0);
    }
  };

  // Extract keypoints from video
  const extractKeypoints = async () => {
    if (!videoRef.current) return;
    setProcessing(true);
    await tf.setBackend("webgl");
    await tf.ready();
    const detector = await poseDetection.createDetector(
      poseDetection.SupportedModels.MoveNet,
      { modelType: poseDetection.movenet.modelType.SINGLEPOSE_LIGHTNING }
    );
    const video = videoRef.current;
    const poses: any[] = [];
    video.currentTime = 0;

    await new Promise((resolve) => {
      if (video.readyState >= 1) resolve(true);
      else video.onloadedmetadata = () => resolve(true);
    });

    const step = 3;
    const frameRate = 30;
    for (let t = 0; t < video.duration; t += step / frameRate) {
      video.currentTime = t;
      await new Promise((resolve) => (video.onseeked = resolve));
      const pose = await detector.estimatePoses(video);
      poses.push(pose[0] || null);
    }
    setKeypoints(poses);
    setProcessing(false);
    setSelectedFrame(0);
  };

  // Download keypoints as JSON
  const downloadKeypoints = () => {
    const blob = new Blob([JSON.stringify(keypoints, null, 2)], { type: "application/json" });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const a = document.createElement("a");
    a.href = url;
    a.download = "keypoints.json";
    a.click();
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  };

  // Draw skeleton for selected frame
  useEffect(() => {
    const canvas = canvasRef.current;
    if (!canvas || !keypoints[selectedFrame]) return;
    const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
    if (!ctx) return;
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

    const pose = keypoints[selectedFrame];
    if (!pose || !pose.keypoints) return;

    const adjacentPairs = poseDetection.util.getAdjacentPairs(poseDetection.SupportedModels.MoveNet);
    adjacentPairs.forEach(([i, j]) => {
      const kp1 = pose.keypoints[i];
      const kp2 = pose.keypoints[j];
      if (
        kp1 &&
        kp2 &&
        kp1.score !== undefined &&
        kp2.score !== undefined &&
        kp1.score > 0.4 &&
        kp2.score > 0.4
      ) {
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(kp1.x, kp1.y);
        ctx.lineTo(kp2.x, kp2.y);
        ctx.strokeStyle = "#64FF58";
        ctx.lineWidth = 3;
        ctx.stroke();
      }
    });

    pose.keypoints.forEach((keypoint: any) => {
      if (keypoint.score && keypoint.score > 0.4) {
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(keypoint.x, keypoint.y, 6, 0, 2 * Math.PI);
        ctx.fillStyle = "#1E3A8A";
        ctx.fill();
      }
    });
  }, [selectedFrame, keypoints]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (videoRef.current && canvasRef.current) {
      const video = videoRef.current;
      const canvas = canvasRef.current;
      const updateCanvasSize = () => {
        canvas.width = video.videoWidth;
        canvas.height = video.videoHeight;
      };
      video.addEventListener("loadedmetadata", updateCanvasSize);
      return () => video.removeEventListener("loadedmetadata", updateCanvasSize);
    }
  }, [videoUrl]);

  // MoveNet keypoints indices
  const indices = {
    leftShoulder: 5,
    rightShoulder: 6,
    leftHip: 11,
    rightHip: 12,
    leftKnee: 13,
    rightKnee: 14,
    leftAnkle: 15,
    rightAnkle: 16,
    leftElbow: 7,
    rightElbow: 8,
    leftWrist: 9,
    rightWrist: 10,
  };

  // Calculate angles for each frame
  const leftKneeAngles = keypoints.map((pose) => {
    if (!pose || !pose.keypoints) return null;
    const hip = pose.keypoints[indices.leftHip];
    const knee = pose.keypoints[indices.leftKnee];
    const ankle = pose.keypoints[indices.leftAnkle];
    if (hip?.score > 0.4 && knee?.score > 0.4 && ankle?.score > 0.4) {
      return getAngle(hip, knee, ankle);
    }
    return null;
  });

  const rightKneeAngles = keypoints.map((pose) => {
    if (!pose || !pose.keypoints) return null;
    const hip = pose.keypoints[indices.rightHip];
    const knee = pose.keypoints[indices.rightKnee];
    const ankle = pose.keypoints[indices.rightAnkle];
    if (hip?.score > 0.4 && knee?.score > 0.4 && ankle?.score > 0.4) {
      return getAngle(hip, knee, ankle);
    }
    return null;
  });

  const leftHipAngles = keypoints.map((pose) => {
    if (!pose || !pose.keypoints) return null;
    const shoulder = pose.keypoints[indices.leftShoulder];
    const hip = pose.keypoints[indices.leftHip];
    const knee = pose.keypoints[indices.leftKnee];
    if (shoulder?.score > 0.4 && hip?.score > 0.4 && knee?.score > 0.4) {
      return getAngle(shoulder, hip, knee);
    }
    return null;
  });

  const rightHipAngles = keypoints.map((pose) => {
    if (!pose || !pose.keypoints) return null;
    const shoulder = pose.keypoints[indices.rightShoulder];
    const hip = pose.keypoints[indices.rightHip];
    const knee = pose.keypoints[indices.rightKnee];
    if (shoulder?.score > 0.4 && hip?.score > 0.4 && knee?.score > 0.4) {
      return getAngle(shoulder, hip, knee);
    }
    return null;
  });

  const leftElbowAngles = keypoints.map((pose) => {
    if (!pose || !pose.keypoints) return null;
    const shoulder = pose.keypoints[indices.leftShoulder];
    const elbow = pose.keypoints[indices.leftElbow];
    const wrist = pose.keypoints[indices.leftWrist];
    if (shoulder?.score > 0.4 && elbow?.score > 0.4 && wrist?.score > 0.4) {
      return getAngle(shoulder, elbow, wrist);
    }
    return null;
  });

  const rightElbowAngles = keypoints.map((pose) => {
    if (!pose || !pose.keypoints) return null;
    const shoulder = pose.keypoints[indices.rightShoulder];
    const elbow = pose.keypoints[indices.rightElbow];
    const wrist = pose.keypoints[indices.rightWrist];
    if (shoulder?.score > 0.4 && elbow?.score > 0.4 && wrist?.score > 0.4) {
      return getAngle(shoulder, elbow, wrist);
    }
    return null;
  });

  const leftShoulderAbdAngles = keypoints.map((pose) => {
    if (!pose || !pose.keypoints) return null;
    const elbow = pose.keypoints[indices.leftElbow];
    const shoulder = pose.keypoints[indices.leftShoulder];
    const hip = pose.keypoints[indices.leftHip];
    if (elbow?.score > 0.4 && shoulder?.score > 0.4 && hip?.score > 0.4) {
      return getAngle(elbow, shoulder, hip);
    }
    return null;
  });

  const rightShoulderAbdAngles = keypoints.map((pose) => {
    if (!pose || !pose.keypoints) return null;
    const elbow = pose.keypoints[indices.rightElbow];
    const shoulder = pose.keypoints[indices.rightShoulder];
    const hip = pose.keypoints[indices.rightHip];
    if (elbow?.score > 0.4 && shoulder?.score > 0.4 && hip?.score > 0.4) {
      return getAngle(elbow, shoulder, hip);
    }
    return null;
  });

  const trunkAngles = keypoints.map((pose) => {
    if (!pose || !pose.keypoints) return null;
    const leftShoulder = pose.keypoints[indices.leftShoulder];
    const leftHip = pose.keypoints[indices.leftHip];
    const rightHip = pose.keypoints[indices.rightHip];
    if (leftShoulder?.score > 0.4 && leftHip?.score > 0.4 && rightHip?.score > 0.4) {
      const midHip = {
        x: (leftHip.x + rightHip.x) / 2,
        y: (leftHip.y + rightHip.y) / 2,
      };
      return getTrunkAngle(leftShoulder, midHip);
    }
    return null;
  });

  function getStats(arr: (number | null)[]) {
    const valid = arr.filter((v): v is number => v !== null);
    if (valid.length === 0) return { min: null, max: null, avg: null };
    const min = Math.min(...valid);
    const max = Math.max(...valid);
    const avg = valid.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / valid.length;
    return { min, max, avg };
  }
  const leftKneeStats = getStats(leftKneeAngles);
  const rightKneeStats = getStats(rightKneeAngles);
  const leftHipStats = getStats(leftHipAngles);
  const rightHipStats = getStats(rightHipAngles);
  const leftElbowStats = getStats(leftElbowAngles);
  const rightElbowStats = getStats(rightElbowAngles);
  const leftShoulderAbdStats = getStats(leftShoulderAbdAngles);
  const rightShoulderAbdStats = getStats(rightShoulderAbdAngles);
  const trunkStats = getStats(trunkAngles);

  const angleChartData = leftKneeAngles.map((_, idx) => ({
    frame: idx + 1,
    leftKnee: leftKneeAngles[idx],
    rightKnee: rightKneeAngles[idx],
    leftHip: leftHipAngles[idx],
    rightHip: rightHipAngles[idx],
    leftElbow: leftElbowAngles[idx],
    rightElbow: rightElbowAngles[idx],
    leftShoulderAbd: leftShoulderAbdAngles[idx],
    rightShoulderAbd: rightShoulderAbdAngles[idx],
    trunk: trunkAngles[idx],
  }));

  const summary = `
Left knee flexion: avg ${leftKneeStats.avg?.toFixed(1) ?? "N/A"}° (min: ${leftKneeStats.min?.toFixed(1) ?? "N/A"}°, max: ${leftKneeStats.max?.toFixed(1) ?? "N/A"}°)
Right knee flexion: avg ${rightKneeStats.avg?.toFixed(1) ?? "N/A"}° (min: ${rightKneeStats.min?.toFixed(1) ?? "N/A"}°, max: ${rightKneeStats.max?.toFixed(1) ?? "N/A"}°)
Left hip flexion: avg ${leftHipStats.avg?.toFixed(1) ?? "N/A"}° (min: ${leftHipStats.min?.toFixed(1) ?? "N/A"}°, max: ${leftHipStats.max?.toFixed(1) ?? "N/A"}°)
Right hip flexion: avg ${rightHipStats.avg?.toFixed(1) ?? "N/A"}° (min: ${rightHipStats.min?.toFixed(1) ?? "N/A"}°, max: ${rightHipStats.max?.toFixed(1) ?? "N/A"}°)
Left elbow flexion: avg ${leftElbowStats.avg?.toFixed(1) ?? "N/A"}° (min: ${leftElbowStats.min?.toFixed(1) ?? "N/A"}°, max: ${leftElbowStats.max?.toFixed(1) ?? "N/A"}°)
Right elbow flexion: avg ${rightElbowStats.avg?.toFixed(1) ?? "N/A"}° (min: ${rightElbowStats.min?.toFixed(1) ?? "N/A"}°, max: ${rightElbowStats.max?.toFixed(1) ?? "N/A"}°)
Left shoulder abduction: avg ${leftShoulderAbdStats.avg?.toFixed(1) ?? "N/A"}° (min: ${leftShoulderAbdStats.min?.toFixed(1) ?? "N/A"}°, max: ${leftShoulderAbdStats.max?.toFixed(1) ?? "N/A"}°)
Right shoulder abduction: avg ${rightShoulderAbdStats.avg?.toFixed(1) ?? "N/A"}° (min: ${rightShoulderAbdStats.min?.toFixed(1) ?? "N/A"}°, max: ${rightShoulderAbdStats.max?.toFixed(1) ?? "N/A"}°)
Trunk angle: avg ${trunkStats.avg?.toFixed(1) ?? "N/A"}° (min: ${trunkStats.min?.toFixed(1) ?? "N/A"}°, max: ${trunkStats.max?.toFixed(1) ?? "N/A"}°)
`.trim();

  const numFrames = keypoints.length;
  const framesWithPerson = keypoints.filter(
    (pose) => pose && pose.keypoints && pose.keypoints.some((kp: any) => kp.score > 0.4)
  ).length;
  const avgConfidence =
    numFrames > 0
      ? (
          keypoints
            .map(
              (pose) =>
                pose &&
                pose.keypoints &&
                pose.keypoints
                  .filter((kp: any) => typeof kp.score === "number")
                  .reduce((sum: number, kp: any) => sum + kp.score, 0) /
                  pose.keypoints.length
            )
            .filter(Boolean)
            .reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / numFrames
        ).toFixed(2)
      : 0;

  if (!authorized) {
    return (
      <main className="min-h-screen flex flex-col items-center justify-center bg-onyx-100">
        <div className="bg-onyx-90 p-8 rounded shadow flex flex-col items-center">
          <h1 className="text-xl font-bold mb-4 text-onyx-10">Admin Access</h1>
          <input
            type="password"
            placeholder="Enter admin password"
            value={input}
            onChange={e => setInput(e.target.value)}
            className="mb-4 px-3 py-2 rounded border border-onyx-30 focus:outline-none"
          />
          <button
            className="bg-blue-100 text-white px-4 py-2 rounded font-bold shadow hover:bg-blue-90 transition"
            onClick={() => {
              if (input === ADMIN_PASSWORD) setAuthorized(true);
              else alert("Incorrect password");
            }}
          >
            Enter
          </button>
        </div>
      </main>
    );
  }

  return (
    <main className="min-h-screen bg-onyx-100 flex flex-col items-center px-4 py-8">
      <h1 className="text-2xl font-extrabold text-onyx-10 mb-4">
        Admin: Upload Reference Video
      </h1>
      <button
        className="bg-blue-100 text-white px-4 py-2 rounded font-bold shadow hover:bg-blue-90 transition cursor-pointer mb-4 inline-block"
        onClick={() => fileInputRef.current?.click()}
        type="button"
      >
        Upload Video
      </button>
      <input
        ref={fileInputRef}
        type="file"
        accept="video/*"
        onChange={handleUpload}
        className="hidden"
      />
      {videoUrl && (

          ref={videoRef}
          src={videoUrl}
          controls
          className="rounded w-[180px] h-[320px] mb-4"

      )}
      {videoUrl && (
        <button
          className="bg-blue-100 text-white px-4 py-2 rounded font-bold shadow-lg hover:bg-blue-90 transition mb-4"
          onClick={extractKeypoints}
          disabled={processing}
        >
          {processing ? "Processing..." : "Extract Keypoints"}
        </button>
      )}
      {keypoints.length > 0 && (
        <>
          <button
            className="bg-green-60 text-white px-4 py-2 rounded font-bold shadow-lg hover:bg-green-70 transition mb-4 border-2 border-green-80"
            onClick={downloadKeypoints}
          >
            ⬇️ Download Keypoints JSON
          </button>
          <div className="mb-4 bg-white rounded p-4 shadow w-full max-w-md">

                  <Tooltip />
```

**User**

incredible. lets also display these angle calculations on the canvas, along with the skeletal overlays, lets position the angle calculations next to each joint so that it is clearly visibile. scale up the canvas if needed to make eveyrhting legible 

---

**Cursor**

To display the angle calculations directly on the canvas next to each relevant joint, you should:

1. **Draw the angle value as text** at the joint (or slightly offset for clarity) after drawing the skeleton and keypoints.
2. **Scale up the canvas** (and its CSS size) to ensure legibility.

Here's how to do it, step by step:

---

### 1. **Prepare Angle Data for the Current Frame**

You already calculate arrays of angles for all frames. For the currently selected frame, extract the relevant angles:

- **Knee flexion**: at the knee joint
- **Hip flexion**: at the hip joint
- **Elbow flexion**: at the elbow joint
- **Shoulder abduction**: at the shoulder joint
- **Trunk angle**: near the mid-hip or shoulder

---

### 2. **Update the Canvas Drawing Logic**

In your `useEffect` that draws the skeleton, after drawing the lines and keypoints, add code to draw the angle values as text.

- Use `ctx.font`, `ctx.fillStyle`, and `ctx.fillText`.
- Offset the text a bit from the joint for clarity.
- Use a contrasting color and a larger font for legibility.

---

### 3. **Scale Up the Canvas**

- Increase the `width` and `height` of the canvas element (both the element and its CSS).
- Make sure the video and canvas are sized together for alignment.

---

### 4. **Example Code Snippet**

Below is a focused code snippet to add inside your skeleton-drawing `useEffect`:

```js
// ... after drawing skeleton and keypoints

// Get the current pose and keypoints
const pose = keypoints[selectedFrame];
if (!pose || !pose.keypoints) return;

// Helper to draw angle text
function drawAngleText(text, x, y, color = "#222", bg = "#fff") {
  ctx.font = "bold 22px Inter, Arial, sans-serif";
  ctx.textAlign = "center";
  ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
  // Draw background for legibility
  ctx.save();
  ctx.fillStyle = bg;
  ctx.globalAlpha = 0.7;
  ctx.fillRect(x - 28, y - 16, 56, 32);
  ctx.restore();
  // Draw text
  ctx.fillStyle = color;
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1.0;
  ctx.fillText(text, x, y);
}

// For each joint/angle, draw the value
```

Excellent! Now let's test the implementation. The changes I've made include:

## Summary of Changes

1. **Added angle text display on canvas**: 
   - Created a `drawAngleText` function that draws angle values with a semi-transparent background for legibility
   - Added a `drawIfValid` helper to only draw angles when valid keypoints are detected
   - Positioned angle text next to each relevant joint (knee, hip, elbow, shoulder, trunk)

2. **Moved angle calculations before the useEffect**: 
   - Relocated all angle calculation logic to before the skeleton drawing useEffect
   - Removed duplicate declarations to fix linter errors

3. **Scaled up the canvas and video**:
   - Increased video size from 180x320px to 320x480px
   - Increased canvas size from 180x320px to 320x480px
   - Updated canvas resolution defaults from 360x640 to 480x720
   - Expanded container width from max-w-md to max-w-lg

4. **Enhanced visual clarity**:
   - Used bold 22px font for angle text
   - Added white background with 70% opacity behind angle text
   - Positioned text with 30px offset from joints for clarity
   - Used consistent color scheme matching the chart colors

The implementation now displays real-time angle calculations directly on the skeleton overlay, making it easy to see the biomechanical analysis as you scrub through frames. The larger canvas ensures all text is clearly legible, and the semi-transparent backgrounds prevent text from being obscured by the skeleton lines.

You can now upload a video, extract keypoints, and see the angle calculations displayed right next to each joint on the skeleton overlay!

Now let me add the helper functions for managing the form arrays and saving the exercise:


```typescriptreact
  const [relatedExerciseInput, setRelatedExerciseInput] = useState("");

  const videoRef = useRef<HTMLVideoElement>(null);
  const fileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const canvasRef = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement>(null);

  // Helper functions for managing form arrays
  const addToArray = (array: string[], value: string, setter: (arr: string[]) => void, inputSetter: (val: string) => void) => {
    if (value.trim() && !array.includes(value.trim())) {
      setter([...array, value.trim()]);
      inputSetter("");
    }
  };

  const removeFromArray = (array: string[], index: number, setter: (arr: string[]) => void) => {
    setter(array.filter((_, i) => i !== index));
  };

  const addInstruction = () => {
    setMetadata(prev => ({
      ...prev,
      instructions: [...prev.instructions, ""]
    }));
  };

  const updateInstruction = (index: number, value: string) => {
    setMetadata(prev => ({
      ...prev,
      instructions: prev.instructions.map((instruction, i) => i === index ? value : instruction)
    }));
  };

  const removeInstruction = (index: number) => {
    setMetadata(prev => ({
      ...prev,
      instructions: prev.instructions.filter((_, i) => i !== index)
    }));
  };

  // Save exercise function
  const saveExercise = () => {
    if (!metadata.title.trim()) {
      alert("Please enter an exercise title");
      return;
    }

    const exerciseData = {
      id: metadata.title.toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, "-"),
      title: metadata.title,
      description: metadata.description,
      image: "/images/squat.jpg", // TODO: Add image upload
      referenceVideoUrl: videoUrl,
      referenceKeypointsUrl: "", // TODO: Save keypoints to file
      tags: metadata.tags,
      equipment: metadata.equipment,
      level: metadata.level,
      muscleGroups: metadata.muscleGroups,
      jointsOfInterest: metadata.jointsOfInterest,
      createdBy: "admin",
      dateAdded: new Date().toISOString(),
      instructions: metadata.instructions.filter(instruction => instruction.trim()),
      author: { 
        name: metadata.authorName, 
        profileUrl: metadata.authorProfileUrl || undefined 
      },
      relatedExercises: metadata.relatedExercises,
    };

    // TODO: Save to database/file system
    console.log("Exercise data to save:", exerciseData);
    
    // For now, just show success message
    alert("Exercise saved successfully! (Check console for data)");
    setShowMetadataForm(false);
  };
```

```typescriptreact
                        className="flex-1 px-3 py-2 border border-onyx-30 rounded focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-100"
                        placeholder="Add joint and press Enter"
                      />
                      <button
                        onClick={() => addToArray(metadata.jointsOfInterest, jointInput, (arr) => setMetadata(prev => ({ ...prev, jointsOfInterest: arr })), setJointInput)}
                        className="px-3 py-2 bg-blue-100 text-white rounded hover:bg-blue-90"
                      >
                        Add
                      </button>
                    </div>
                    <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                      {metadata.jointsOfInterest.map((joint, index) => (
                        <span key={index} className="bg-onyx-20 text-onyx-10 px-2 py-1 rounded text-sm flex items-center gap-1">
                          {joint}
                          <button onClick={() => removeFromArray(metadata.jointsOfInterest, index, (arr) => setMetadata(prev => ({ ...prev, jointsOfInterest: arr })))}>×</button>
                        </span>
                      ))}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Instructions */}
              <div className="mt-6">
                <h3 className="text-lg font-semibold text-onyx-10 mb-4">Instructions</h3>
                <div className="space-y-3">
                  {metadata.instructions.map((instruction, index) => (
                    <div key={index} className="flex gap-2">
                      <span className="text-sm font-medium text-onyx-20 mt-2">{index + 1}.</span>
                      <input
                        type="text"
                        value={instruction}
                        onChange={(e) => updateInstruction(index, e.target.value)}
                        className="flex-1 px-3 py-2 border border-onyx-30 rounded focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-100"
                        placeholder={`Step ${index + 1}...`}
                      />
                      {metadata.instructions.length > 1 && (
                        <button
                          onClick={() => removeInstruction(index)}
                          className="px-3 py-2 text-red-600 hover:text-red-800"
                        >
                          ×
                        </button>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  ))}
                  <button
                    onClick={addInstruction}
                    className="text-blue-100 hover:text-blue-90 text-sm font-medium"
                  >
                    + Add Step
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Related Exercises */}
              <div className="mt-6">
                <h3 className="text-lg font-semibold text-onyx-10 mb-2">Related Exercises</h3>
                <div className="flex gap-2 mb-2">
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    value={relatedExerciseInput}
                    onChange={(e) => setRelatedExerciseInput(e.target.value)}
                    onKeyPress={(e) => e.key === 'Enter' && addToArray(metadata.relatedExercises, relatedExerciseInput, (arr) => setMetadata(prev => ({ ...prev, relatedExercises: arr })), setRelatedExerciseInput)}
                    className="flex-1 px-3 py-2 border border-onyx-30 rounded focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-100"
                    placeholder="Add related exercise ID and press Enter"
                  />
                  <button
                    onClick={() => addToArray(metadata.relatedExercises, relatedExerciseInput, (arr) => setMetadata(prev => ({ ...prev, relatedExercises: arr })), setRelatedExerciseInput)}
                    className="px-3 py-2 bg-blue-100 text-white rounded hover:bg-blue-90"
                  >
                    Add
                  </button>
                </div>
                <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                  {metadata.relatedExercises.map((exercise, index) => (
                    <span key={index} className="bg-onyx-20 text-onyx-10 px-2 py-1 rounded text-sm flex items-center gap-1">
                      {exercise}
                      <button onClick={() => removeFromArray(metadata.relatedExercises, index, (arr) => setMetadata(prev => ({ ...prev, relatedExercises: arr })))}>×</button>
                    </span>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Action Buttons */}
              <div className="flex justify-end gap-4 mt-8 pt-6 border-t border-onyx-30">
                <button
                  onClick={() => setShowMetadataForm(false)}
                  className="px-6 py-2 border border-onyx-30 text-onyx-20 rounded hover:bg-onyx-20 transition"
                >
                  Cancel
                </button>
                <button
                  onClick={saveExercise}
                  className="px-6 py-2 bg-blue-100 text-white rounded font-medium hover:bg-blue-90 transition"
                >
                  Save Exercise
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </main>
  );
}
```
